notesStmt.note:
MUKTABODHA INDOLOGICAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE and INSTITUT FRANCAIS DE PONDICHERYCatalog number : I00021 Uniform title: śivotsavavidhi Manuscript : IFP manuscript 27544 Description: This text deals with the performance of the festival of śiva as it occurs in different āgamas. Bundle contains dhanurmāsapūjāvidhi kṛttikādoopanirṇaya navarātriutsavavidhi kāmikāgama - skandasaṣṭi-utsava ekakṣaranighaṇṭu rakṣoghnahoma mudrālakṣaṇa ṣoḍaśopacāra dravyāhutivacana - sakalāgamasaṅgraha viṣṇulibreofficvatidravyāhuti cintyāgama yogaja (utsavavidhi) sūkṣmāgama (utsava) makuṭāgama (śivotsava) prāyaścittavidhi āṣāḍhapūrārmavidhi - kāraṇa kāmikāgama - śivotsava
There are 200 folios in this bundle. Notes: This e text was produced under an agreement between the IFP (Institut Francais de Pondichery) and The Muktabodha Indological Research Institute, India.
The e-text was prepared by the staff of the IFP, Sambandhan Anandavardhana (Research Associate) and Arul Nandi (Research Assistant) under the supervision of Dr. Deviprasad Mishra (Project Co-ordinator).
The project was funded by the Muktabodha Indological Research Institute, India

body.re:
<śivotsavavidhiḥ>
<• [] symbols are (may be) errors.Words/letters within brackets are my suggestions (as far as my > <• understanding)> <• dots ((…).) are used to mention the missing parts/leaf damage/unidentified characters> <• mostly 7 lines on each side of the folios> <• P=pdf picture> <• (—) symbols areused to mention the shlokas>
<(viṣaya sūcikā)> <01 ekākṣaranikhaṇḍu muṇ 30 tīrthasaṅgrahaṇam muṇ> <02 (cintye) śivotsavam piṇ 31 cūrṇotsavam piṇ> <03 dhvajārohaṇam muṇ 31 tīrthasaṅgrahaṇam muṇ> <06 vṛṣādhivāsanam muṇ 32 ghaṭasnānam piṇ> <08 dhvajārohaṇam piṇ 33 dhvadāvarohaṇam muṇ> <09 bherītāḍanam muṇ 34 maunabali piṇ> <11 kautukabandhanam piṇ 34 utsavaprāyaścittam piṇ> <12 maṇḍapalakṣaṇam piṇ 35 dhvajānarohaṇaprāyaścittam muṇ> <14 vāstuhomam muṇ 38 bherītāḍhanaprāyaścittam piṇ> <16 yāgapūjai muṇ 39 kautukabandhanaprāyaścittam muṇ> <16 śivayāgam muṇ 40 yāgamaṇḍapaprāyaścittam piṇ> <17 balikramam muṇ 42 balidānaprāyaścittam muṇ> <22 yānakramam piṇ 45 kautukabandhanaprāyaścittam muṇ> <24 naṭeśotsavam muṇ 47 rathārohaṇaprāyaścittam piṇ> <26 aśvārohaṇam piṇ 49 tīrthāṅkuraprāyaścittam muṇ> <28 rathārohaṇam piṇ 80 cintyāgamapaṭalam piṇ> <30 tīrthasaṅgrahaṇam muṇ >
(P. 5b,1st line)
||[dhanurmāsapūjāvidhi]|| triṃśaddinaṃ uṣaḥkālaṃ dinādhikyantu varjayet| eke(ko)natriṃśaddivasā kathaṃṃ śaṃbho maheśvarā|| (2nd line)
pūrvamāse militvā ca dinamekaṃ śivārcanam| sahasradinapūjāñca tatphalaṃ ekasandhiṣu|| yasmin dine prabhāte ca sāyaṃ mādhyāndine raviḥ| (3rd line) cāpa saṃkramaṇaṃ kuryāt taddinātu surārcanam|| iti kāraṇe|| pradoṣe udayaṃ bhānu kodaṇḍaḥ te divākarau|(4th line) viṃśa(…)parādūrdhvaṃ uṣaṃ taddinaṃ arcayet| makarādyantu ṣāṇmāsaṃ devānāntu divāsmṛtaḥ||(5th line) kaṭakāvrantu ṣāṇmāsaṃ devarātrimiti smṛtam| māsekaṃ pañcanāḍiṃsyāt ṣāṇmāsañcaiva jyeṣṭhatye|(6th line) āṣāḍhe pañcanāḍiṃ syāt ṣāṇmāsaṃ mārgaśīrṣatye| kodaṇḍasthe savitari pratyuṣaḥ pūjayecchivam| pañcaviṃśati (P.6a,1st line) uṣaḥkāle uttamantu vidhīyate| saptaviṃśatyuṣaḥkāle madhyamantu vidhīyate| aṣṭāviṃśatyuṣaḥ kāle adhamantu bhidhīyyate|(2nd line) śuddhānnaṃ dadhi saṃyuktaṃ śuṇḍikā cūrṇamiśritam| āmalakamādṛkañca sarṣacūrṇantu saṃyutam| vyañjanaṃ bālakandādinaiva (*)vrantu viśeṣataḥ|(*)(3rd line) dvādaśābdaphalaṃ tasmaiḥ dine na ekena sidhyati|| (P.6b,1st line)
|| [kṛttikādīpanirṇayavidhiḥ]|| ubhau ma(…)viracadīpārohantu nāśanam| budhaśukrendujīvāyāṃ dīpārohaṇamuttamam||(2nd line) ajite(—) ūrjemāsi sa(…)kāyāṃ nakṣatre vahni devate| tasmin pradoṣakāle tu kṛttikādīpamācaret|| kevalaṃ paurṇamāsyāntu pradoṣe vā samācaret| (3rd line) ravivāregninakṣatre saparvaṃ vā caturdaśī|| tacchreṣṭaṃ dīpamityuktaṃ madhyamau sauribhūmijau(4th line) pauṣkare(—) kṛ(…)bharaṇīcaiva taddine ca caturdaśī| madhyāhnāparatokasya grahaṇaṃ yadisaṃbhavet||(5th line) āpūrṇā arddharātrau vā gṛhaṇaṃ yadicet bhavet| dīpotsavaṃ na kurvīta pūrvevā aparamācaret|| paurṇimāyāntithau rātrau (*)gṛhaṇaṃ yadicet bhavet|(*)(6th line) dīpotsavaṃ na kurvīta paredyuḥ dīpamācaret|| kṛttikābharaṇī miśrā taddine caturdaśī|(P.7a,1st line) madhyāhnāt parato vāpi grahaṇaṃ yadisaṃbhavet|| dīpotsavantu kurvīta pūrvasminvābare nicaret| vṛścike karke vidhau tuṅge (*)pūrṇāyāmagnibhe vṛṣe||(*)(2nd line) parāgena kurvīta mahādīpa prarohaṇaṃ| mṛgendre(—) yatkaścit parvasaṃyuktaṃ kṛttikādīpa(*)mācaret|||(*)(3rd line) madhyama prokta saṃyuktaṃ rājarāṣṭrasamaṃ gatim|| bhīmasaṃhitāyām(—) kevalaṃ kṛttikā yuktaṃ taddine ca caturdaśī| dīpotsavaṃ na kurvīta (*)kuryācet rāṣṭranāśanam||(*)(4th line) kāraṇe(—) rohaṇyāṃ vā bharaṇyāṃ vā dīpaṃ parvaṇi kārayet| aparvaṇyāṃ kṛte dīpe tadgrāmaṃ rāṣṭranāśanam|| (5th line) kāmike(—) bharaṇī rohiṇīcaiva mṛgaśīrṣamayaṃ tathā| parvapradhānamityuktaṃ pradoṣadīpamācaret|| (P. 7b,1st line) || āvāhanakram|| liṅgamūrdhnirubhayośca pārśve dvātriṃśat mūrttagam| pratimā hṛdisthā śaktyā kṛtiḥ śailajalohastham|| busta (…) vastrantisthita tasya jīvaḥ|(*)(2nd line) rathetu mūrdhni sthūpi nāsike vā vaṭapratiṣṭā(ṣṭhā)|| iti citraśnottare(praśnottare)|(3rd line) īśasya mūrdhni śūlasya madhye śikharasya kukṣau| skandasya śaktirathasya mūrdhā vṛṣagniṃ gavāgre||(4th line) śaktyādi śailajalohajānāṃ stanau vasanti satataṃ sañjīvāḥ| || [dīpāvalisnānam]||(5th line)(side heading) tailalakṣmījale gaṅgādvīpāvali tithau vaset| alakṣmī parihārārthā(tu)bhyaṃ garbhnān mācaret||(6th line) āśvījamāseṣvapareṣupakṣe caturdaśyāmapi aruṇodayeṣu|| tailoṣṇasnānaṃ sikatājaleṣu gaṅgāsnānamapi turevatṛptiḥ|(P. 8a,1st line) aśvayut kṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāmi nārthaye| snānamabhyaṅga karttavyaṃ naraiḥnarakabhīrubhiḥ||(2nd line) aśvayut kṛṣṇapakṣasya caturdaśyāṃ mahāniśamya| narakāsuramardañca abhyaṅga snānamācaret||(P. 8b,1st line) ||[navarātri utsavavidhi]||(side heading) māsebhādṛ(…)da śukle daśamyārādhanaṃ guha| sātithau mṛgayātrāñca śaivāgameṣu bhāṣitam|| kāraṇe(—) bhādre śukle ca(*)daśamī navame ca dinadvayam|(*)(2nd line) sātithikhaṇḍitācchetumaparaṃ grāhyamuttamam|| kāmike(—) bhāskarodayamārabhya daśamī navanāḍike|(3rd line) taddine mṛgayatrān sātithiruttamottamam|| yogaje(—) kanyāmāse sitepakṣe daśamyāñca śamīyajet| pūrvāhe (*)vā parā he vā daśahe tithisaṃbhave||(*)(4th line) tatkāletu viśeṣeṇa vidhivat pūjayet guruḥ| ajite(—)(5th line) daśamyāṃ pūjayeddevaṃ udaye uttamaṃ bhavet| madhyāhne madhyamaṃjñeyaṃ sāyaṅkāledhamaṃ bhavet|| vṛddhevāthakṣayo(*)vāpi daśāhetu śamīyajet|(*)(6th line) udayādyāmahīne tu pūrvedyuḥ pūjayet guruḥ|| niśvāsakārikāyām(—) yā tithi samanuprāpya(*) udayaṃ yāti bhāskaram|(*)(7th line) sātithi sakalājñeyaṃ tīthyaṃpūjādi karmasu|| kanyāśukla prathamadivase daśamevābhi rātrau|(P. 9a,1st line) nityaṃ jalpyaṃ hutayajanavrataṃ āsuraṃ samhārārtham|| gaurīmīśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ guhamabhicasareṃ śekharaṃ sundaraṃ vā| śamīrūpaṃ(*) haranti daśa sukhakaraṃ mucyate śāṃbhavena||(*)(2nd line) sihmāsuradhoyyukta parāśaktiṃ jayapradam| hastraṃ śastraṃ śamīmūle arcayet(*) vijayapradam||(*)(3rd line) vimānaṃ turagañcaiva bhūtañcaiva gajaṃvṛṣam| kāmadhenuñca vṛkṣañca ardhehaṃsañca sa(…)ham|| mayūraṃ śu(*)kasihmañca khaṭvādīnāñca ḍolakam|(*)(4th line) ityādīnāmalaṃkṛtya mūlaśaktiñcabhāvayet|| svāyaṃbhuve(—) daśamyāṃ śamīpūjā(5th line) sahasre(—) amāyan(…)samārabhya daśamyārādhanaṃ guhā| sāyāhne tithisamprāpte taddine mṛgayātrakā|| athavā prathamā|(6th line) makuṭe(—) kanyāmāse sitepakṣe daśāhetu tithidvaye| śamīpūjāñca karttavyaṃ daśamīñcaivakārayet|| anyatra tithipūjāñca (*)rājādurjayamāpnuyāt|(7th line) grāmakartruvināśāya dhanadhānyavināśanam||(P. 9b,1st line) [skandaṣaṣṭi utsavavidhi(—)] kauśika uvāca(-) devadevajagannātha deveśaḥ vṛṣabhadhvajā| skandaṣaṣṭikramañcaiva utsavasyakramaṃ tathā|| vṛto(*)tpannantathā tīrthaṃ brūhi me tripurāntakā|(*)(2nd line) śivauvāca(—) athātassaṃpravakṣyāmi skandaṣaṣṭyutsavaṃ bhavet|(3rd line) sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam|| ārogyamāyuḥkīrttiñca dhanadhānyasamuddhidam|(4th line) yuddhakāle jayakaraṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam|| rājalakṣmībhavet samyak putrasampaktimevaca|(5th line) ihaiva sakalaṃ bhūtvā parato mokṣamāpnuyāt|| vratotpattiḥ pravakṣyāmi śruṇu kauśika suvṛtā|(6th line) purā tārakasaṃjñena asureṇa durātmanā|| brahmāviṣṇu surendrāśca trailokaṃ sacarācaram| bādhitāścirakālāśca (*)krūropadravapīḍanam||(*)(P. 10a,1st line) tat kāle lokarakṣārthaṃ jātasvāmi ṣaḍānanaḥ| kadācit sarvadevāśca kailāsa(*)jagamīdarāt||(*)(2nd line) prathamaṃ śivadevāśca jādantejohamatviti| dvitīyadivase tejaḥ pārvatyurmadagantathā|| tritīye cāgni(*)hastasthaṃ caturtheśakramantatha|(*)(3rd line) pañceme kṛttikāṃ prāpya ṣaṣṭe jātaḥ kumāraṣaṭ|| tadārabhya kumārasya(*) skandaṣaṣṭipriyaṃbhavet|(*)(4th line) tatkāle sarvadevāśca anuṣṭāya mahāvratam|| nityatvaṃ iṣṭasiddhiñca pravede(*) skandavaibhavāt|(*)(5th line) yathā kalpavidhānoktaṃ tathāsarvaṃ samācaret|| tulāmāse tu samprāpte (*)prathamāyāntithau śūcau|(*)(6th line) karttavyaṃ ṣaṇmukhasyāsya pūjā ṣaṣṭyantamuttamam|| tulāmāse sitepakṣe prathametu vratañcaret|(P. 10b,1st line) ṣaṣṭyāntaṃ vṛścikemāse skandaṣaṣṭi vratañcaret|| tathevratasya yanmāsaṃ tasyamāsaṃ sampradhānakam| anyamāsetu(*) āraṃbhaṃ tatpūjā niṣpa(ṣpha)laṃ bhavet|| (*)(2nd line) amāviṃśat ghaṭikā ca tadūrdhve prathamābhavet| tadārabhyavrataṃ kuryāt vṛddhiścet (*)aparehani||(*)(3rd line) sarvaḥvrateṣu tīrtheṣu madhyāhne vyāpiniścitam| natte sāyandinaṃṃ vyāpi tithirapyevamucyate||(4th line) etat vrataṃ samākhyātaṃ sarvakāryeṣu pūjitam| sarvān kāmānavāpnoti subrahmaṇyaḥ prasādataḥ||(5th line) vratotsavaṃ ahaṃ vakṣye śruṇu kauśika suvṛta| skandaṣaṣṭivṛtaṃ syāsya trividhak samamaṃbhavet|| mūlaberāt(*) kecaiva vṛtaṃ kuṃbhantu maṇḍalam|(*)(6th line) ṣaḍaśraṃ kuṇḍahomañca rakṣābandhanamācaret|| kevalamañcocavaḥ kuryāt kanya(*)savanviti kīrtitam|(*)(P. 11a,1st line) kuṇḍaṃ vinātu berāgrekuṃbha maṇḍalasaṃyutam|| yāgakuṃbhañca kuṇḍañca yāgaśālāṃ prapūjayet| utsavārthantu(*) beraṃsyāt rakṣābandhanamācart||(*)(2nd line) homaṃbaliḥkramaṃ kuryāt cūrṇa tīrthantuṣaṣṭhake| madhyamantu iti vikhyātaṃ(*) uttamañca tataḥ śruṇu||(*)(3rd line) pūrvoktena krameṇaiva śikhidhvajasamanvitam| uttamantu iti vikhyātaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam||(4th line) kuṃbhe ca maṇḍale ca eva bimbe ca trividhaṃ bhavet| kuṃbhe caturbhujopetaṃ maṇḍale tvi(dvi)bhujaṃ bhavet|| bimbe(*) tvā(dvā)daśahastañca arcayetu vidhānataḥ|(*)(5th line) maṇḍalasya kramaṃ vakṣye pūrvorasamakantathā|| ṣoḍaśāṅgula vistāraṃ (*)maṇḍalañcaturāśrakam| (*)(6th line) dalaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulañcaiva karṇikācaturaṅgulam|| pītañca karṇikāmadhye raktavarṇena ṣaṭdalam| anteṣu śveta(*)mityuktaṃ kṛṣṇabimbamitīritam||(*)(P. 11b,1st line) dalānumapare śyāmaṃ kalpayet kalpayetṣaṭdalāmbujam| paścāt padmasyabāhyetu kṣmāyantaṃ(*) paritolikhet||(*)(2nd line) agnirākṣasa vāyuṣvīkoṇeṣu ca catuṣpade| mattaśyāmo kṛṣṇaśveta varṇamuktaṃ mahāmune||(3rd line) ṣaṭsūtraṃ kalpitaṃ doraṃpumānnārī viśeṣataḥ| dakṣiṇe tu karevāme budhniyāt ścitaścita vrataḥ|| uveṣya peratimāyāntu(*) datvā brāhmaṇabhojanam|(*)(4th line) dinedinevanaimityuktaṃ kuryānnitya manantritam|| ṣaṣcāntithau ca prāptāyāṃ prathamotsavamācaret|(5th line) etat vrataṃ samākhyātaṃ sarvakāryeṣu siddhidam|| sarvān kāmānavāpnoti subrahmaṇyaprasādanam| vrato(*)tsavamahaṃ vakṣye sarvakāmaphalapradam||(*)(6th line) māsecāśvayaje śukle prathamāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ| dhvajāropaye vidvān sarvalokahitāya ca||(P. 12a,1st line) aṅkuraṃ vāstuśuddhiñcā viśeṣayajanantathā| vratakuṃbhaṃ saṃsthāpya maṇḍalañca tataḥ param| dhvajaṃpaṭaṃ tataḥ snāpyamayurāgre viśeṣataḥ||(2nd line) bheritāḍanayet paścāt astradevaṃ samarcayet| utsaveśaṃ guheśañca svaśaktisahitaṃ yajet|| rakṣāsūtrañca badhvātu kuryāt(*) grāmapradakṣiṇam|(3rd line) dikdevatā samāvāhya dhvajamāropayet kramāt|| yāgapūjāntataḥ kuryāt kuṃbhān saṃsthāpayet guruḥ|(4th line) madhye pradhānakuṃbhañca pārśve śaktintathaiva ca|| viśveśvaraghaṭānaṣṭau vedimadhye prapūjayet|(5th line) yāgeśvaraghaṭāścaiva dvārapālaghaṭānapi|| lokapālaghaṭāṃścaiva pūjayet dhvajamaṅgalāt| āyudhāntoraṇānāñca(*)aṅkuraṃ kuṇḍavedikam|| (*)(6th line) krameṇa pūjayet paścāt dhūpadīpa samarpitam| darpaṇaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhañca mayūrañcāmaradvayam||(P. 12b,1st line) kukkuṭaṃ kamalandīpañcaivāṣṭamaṅgalam| vajraśaktiñca cāpañca khaḍgaṃbāṇantathaiva ca|| kukkuṭantu gatāśūlaṃ padmañcakrantathaiva ca|(2nd line) evandaśāyudhaṃ dikṣu sthāpayet kramaśastathā|| kuṇḍānyaika tripañcāni kṛtvāhomaṃ samācaret| agnyādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ agni(*)kāryoktamācaret||(*)(3rd line) bimbevaktre ca vanhau ca utsavasya kubarake| evaṃ pañcavidhaṃ devaṃ dhyayātvā mantreṇa pūjayet||(4th line) samidhāskandamantreṇa ājyamūlena homayet| caruṃ kumāramantreṇa lājaṃ senānimantrataḥ| sarṣapaṃ guhamantreṇa tilaṃvai(*) kārtikena ca||(*)(5th line) skandagāyatrīmantreṇa anyadravyāṇi homayet| ayaṃ kumāramantreṇa aṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet||(6th line) mātekumāramantreṇa prāyaścittaṃ tathaivaca| jayādirabhyādhānāñca rāṣṭrantañca hunet kramāt|| pūrṇāhutiñca mūlena baliṃ(*) kuryāt vicakṣaṇaḥ|(*)(P.13a,1st line) utsaveśaṃ guheśañcāsnapanādyai tato yajet|| phaleśca vividhai caiva gandhapuṣpañca dhūpakaiḥ|(2nd line) dīpainai(pairnai)vedyakaiścaiva alaṅkṛtya viśeṣataḥ|| bhūṣaṇaiścaiva saṃbhūṣai(ṣaiḥ)naivedyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yajet| evaṃ dvikālamabhyarcya(*)homañca balidānakam||(*)(3rd line) kṛtvā nainittikaṃ kāmya nityakarmapurassaram| grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sāyaṃ prāta(taḥ)viśeṣataḥ||(4th line) chatraṃ cāmarañcaiva dhvajaṃ vyajanameva ca| nānā vidhasamāyuktaṃ nānāvādya samāyutam|| nānā bhaktajanairyuktaṃ (*)nānā nṛttasamāyutam|(*)(5th line) anyaiścaivopacāraiśca rājacihnaiḥ anekaśaḥ|| evaṃ bahuvidhairyuktaṃ kuryāt (*)grāmapradakṣiṇam| (*)(6th line) ālayaṃ praviśet paścāt āstānaṃ ca tataḥ param|| naivedyaṃ dāpayet devaṃ dīpārādhanameva ca| nṛttagītasamāyuktaṃ(*) evaṃ kuryā(…)|| (*)(P.13b,1st line) prathame sarvadevebhyo dvitīye asure tathā| tatīye brahmaṇocaiva yoginyaiśca caturthake||(2nd line) pañcame śivaśaktibhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhedadyāt line) punaḥ tilamiśra kārpāsabījena hutvā| oṃ dahāśaso svāhā| oṃ śarmasvāhā| oṃ atratyāvāḥ svāhā| (4th line)oṃ bhuvasvāhā| oṃ atra svāhā| oṃ suvasvāhā| oṃ atra svāhā| oṃ bhūrbhuvassuvasvāhā| (5th line) iti trirīvṛtya| sampātāhuti hutva(tvā)| ye devāḥpurassada iti duvassate rakṣoghne svāhetyantaṃ ājyena hutvā| tataḥ agneḥ purataḥ| vṛṣṭivāhiradho dakṣiṇā svāhā| iti raktānnena balindatvā| devasyatvetyādi bhūtam(P.21b,F.3a,1st line) rakṣayitvāntaṃ pūrvavat vyāhṛtyā| trirāvartya| saṃpādāhutiṃ hutvā| mūlena pūrvandatvā| svāheti sviṣṭakṛt hutvā| antarbali (2nd line) bahirbalindatvā| vanhisthaṃ devaṃ kuṃbhe saṃyojya| kuṃbhasthaṃ hṛdaye saṃyojya sampādājya kuṃbhajale saṃyojya(3rd line) khaḍgañca śūlañca paricārakahaste datvā| purato nityā| kuṃbhajalena pavamānamantreṇa garbhādhānādi sarvālayaṃ prokṣya| [rakṣoghnahomavidhi samāptaḥ]||hariḥ om||
liṅgaśca mūrdhnirubhayoḥ ca pārśve vā triṃṃśanmūrtti pratimāhuṃ sthāśaktyā kṛtaśailaja loha bimbaṃ stanyau vadantisthita(4th line) tasya jīvaḥ| mūrdhnāsthūpi nāsike vā paṭapratiṣṭhā iti citraśrotre| īśasyamūrdhni śūlasya madhye śikharasya kukṣau(P.22a.,F.1b,1st line) skandabhyaśakti rathasya mūrdhā vṛṣaśraṅgacāgre| śaktayādi śailajalohajānāṃ stanauvasanti satataṃ sajīvātu tailalakṣmīṃ jale gaṅgā(2nd line) dvīpāvalī tithau vaset| alakṣmīparihārārthaṃ abhyaṅgā snānamācaret| āṣvījamāseṣvapareṣu pakṣe ca kartṛbhyāmapi aruṇodayeṣu|(3rd line) tailoṣṇasnānaṃ sikatājaleṣu gaṅgāsamānaṃ citrameva tṛptiḥ| avayukkṛṣṇapakṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ nādvaye| (4th line) snānamabhyaṅga kartavyaṃ naraiḥ narakabhīrubhiḥ| avayukkṛṣṇapakṣasya ca kartṛbhyāṃ mahānarau| narakāsuramartyañca abhyaṅgasnānamācaret|(5th line) pūrakarmaṃ|(?) kukṣivaktranayane sapādukau(-)nābhi(-)hṛtgala(-)lalāṭa(-)mūrdhni(-) annataṇḍula śāli sukṛtkuśa mudgayā trilavaṇa kuśākṣatā|(6th line) śivaśakti samutpannaṃ lokasyotpatattikāraṇam| vṛṣadhīnāṃ pravṛtyantaṃ bījadānamihocyate| ātmasṛṣṭikaraṃ proktaṃ saukhyaṃlavaṇadāṇakam|(7th line) kanyakāṃ pradātavyaṃ svarṇaṃ vai vastradānakam| svarṇaṃ lokasyarakṣārthaṃ vastraṃ putravivardhanam| gaurīdānaṃ bhavettasmāt sarvaprāṇi sukhāvahaḥ||(P.22b,F.2a,1st line) kāraṇe(—) kṛsarānnañcamaghore ca lavaṇantilacūrṇakam| tat tailamabhighārañca rudraprītikaraṃ bhaveta||(2nd line) pratiṣṭhotsava tanmadhye gṛtābhāve tu durlabham| tilatailañca karttavyaṃ homayetu viśeṣataḥ||(3rd line)|| iti svāyaṃbhuve|| annaśuddhirghṛtābhāve tilatailañca śudhyati| marīci(*) sindhusammignaṃ śuddhānantu mihocyate||(*)(4th line) kāmike(—) apūpādi ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ kārayet (*)tilatailakam|(*)(5th line) nālikerañca anya tailaṃ vivarjayet||(6th line) dīpārādhane kāletu dīpañca patitannayet| aghorāstra dhaśaṃ japtvā punardīpaṃ praropayat|(7th line) (ரும்வரி) tat tailaṃ| (புள்ளடி)(P.23a.,F.2b,1st line)
|| naivedya vidhi|| naivedyañca vidhaṃ vakṣye mama prītikaraṃ śubham| śraddhayā śruṇvate devīṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam||(2nd line) sidhyantu sarvakāryāṇi sarvasaubhāgyadāyakam|21 īśānake tu śuddhānnaṃ gulānnaṃ puruṣasya tu|| kṛsarānnamaghore ca (*)mudgānnañca tathottare|(*)(3rd line) paścimepāyasānnantu pañcavaktraṃ nivedayet||22||(4th line) pakvānte lavaṇañcaiva marīciñcaiva muṇḍayuk| ghṛtamiśrañca ityevaṃ śuddhānnantu prakīrta śatāḥ||23||(5th line) taṇḍulārdhaṃ mudgabhinnaṃ tadardhaṃ galameva ca| tadardhaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ sindhuyuktaṃ gulodanam||24|| śivataṇḍula(*)pakvānte lavaṇañcaivapūritam|(*)(6th line) prasthārdhaṃ tilacūrṇañca tat samaṃ tilatailakam|| ityeva dakṣiṇovaktre (*)kṛsarānnañcamihocyate||25||(*)(7th line) taṇḍulārdhantu mudgañca mudgārdhaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam| pakvānte lavaṇañcaiva mudgānnaṃ (*)tu tathottare||26||(*)(P.23b,F.3a,1st line) taṇḍulaṃ triguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrārdhaṃ toyamevaca| toyārdhaṃ mudgabhinnañca pāyasānnantu (*)paścime||27||(*)(2ndline) śivataṇḍulamannañca tintriṇīñca diśeḥ phalam| prasthapāda tilaistailaṃ kuḍumbārdhantu sarṣapam|| kṛṣṇa(*)nimbai śuṣṇapatraṃ lavaṇañcaiva saṃyutam|(*)(3rd line) evaṃ tintriṇi annantu devyānāntu nivedayeta||28||(4th line) śivataṇaḍulamityuktaṃ prasthārdhaṃ māṣacūrṇakam| tadardhaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ lavaṇañcaiva saṃyutam|| evaṃ gaurīntu (*)māṣānnamiti kathyate|29||(*)(5th line) dadhyodanaṃ nāgarasindhuyuktaṃ jaṃbhīrasaṃ elake śriṅgiberam|| ni्ramālya (*)paryūṣitaṃ aṣṭapuṣpam| (*)(6th line) devāya dadyāt udayādikāle||201||(?) śivataṇḍulamardhañca bhinnahīnantu mutgakam| śarkarāñca (*)phalaṃ viṃśat nālikerantu cūrṇa yuk||(*)(P.24a.,F.3b,1st line) ghṛtañca pṛsthapūrintu pakvānte lavaṇairyutam| elācūrṇañca saṃyuktaṃ (*)citrānnamiti kathyate||211||(*)(2nd line) atipakvavamapakvañca atyuṣṇamatiśītalam| keśapāṣāṇa jantūnāṃ kriśiraṃ parivarjayet||(3rd line) kukṣirogaṃ gulmarogaṃ grandhirogantathaivaca| kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭhāśca jvararogādi saṃbhavam||212|| kṣīraṃ(-)guulaṃ(-)(*)madhuṃ(-)tailaṃ(-)dadhi(-)sarpiñca ṣaḍrasaṃ|(*)(4th line) annañcaiva tu etatye ṣaḍrasānnamihocyate||213|| nāgapañcaphaṇopetaṃ (*)kṣīrāpmānasamānakam|(*)(5th line) tat sārantugṛhṇīyāt yāvat devānubhojanam||214|| vṛkṣamūlasya (*)secana yathā śākovaśākinam|(*)(6th line) tathā ca devatābhuktaṃ mūlaliṅgaṃ nivedayet||215|| kapitthasya (*)phalaṃ sāraṃ yāvat kuñjarabhakṣaṇam|(*)(7th line) tat sārantu gṛhṇīyāt yāvat devānubhojanam||216||(P.24b,F.1a,1st line)
||[mudrālakṣaṇam]|| mudaṃ karoti devānāṃ drāvayatyasirāṃ(tya surāṃ)stathā| modanāddrāvaṇāt ca eṣāṃ mudreyaṃ parikīrttitāḥ|| tat dvayādadhaḥ (*)kṛtvā karamudrāṃ na bandhayet|(*)(2nd line) mudrādāne tataḥ śaṃbho hṛddeśe tānnidarśayet|| siddhānte(—) aṅguṣṭāt mubhau (*)karṇau tarjanībhyāṃ athākṣiṇi|(*)(3rd line) madhyamābhyāṃ nibadhniyā nāsikā yugalādṛḍham|| ṣaṇmukhīkaraṇaṃ hyetat snānakarmāṇi(*)yojayet|(*)(4th line) dakṣiṇaṃ hastamuktā na tarjanyāṃ kuñcitantathā|| yeṣamuṣṭintu saṃbandhamaindra yañcākuśasya tu|(5th line) vīratantre(—) uttānau tu karau kṛtvā maṇibandhantu kārayet| vāmahastasya ca ūrdhve tu dakṣiṇamvinyaset tataḥ|| (6th line) vāmāṅguṣṭhasya cordhve tu dakṣiṇaṃ vinyasettataḥ| vāmāṅguṣṭhasya cordhve tu dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakanyaset||(7th line) madhyame suṣiraṃ kuryāt ca teṣāṅgulaśca kārayet| kuṃbhamudrābhavet eṣā snānakāle prayojayet||(P.25a.,F.1b,1st line) kālottare(—) uttānau tu karau kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhatarjanī ubhe| śeṣā vai muṣṭibadhvā tu annamudrā prakīrta (ga)śatāḥ||(2nd line) amśumati(—) āropya vāmahastasya kaniṣṭhānābhamaṇḍale| tamevadakṣahastasya vāmāṅguṣṭhena yojayet|| vitatau ca karau (*)kṛtvā dakṣāṅguṣṭhenyase mukhe|(*)(3rd line) pariya ca samākhyātā duṣṭābhārā vināśinī|| uttāna śidhirimuṣṭi (*)vahnādipakṣeva utbhavamudreti bhojadevaḥ|(*)(4th line) suprabhede(—) pāṇimūlau tu saṃlagnahṛddeśe tu parasparam| kṛtve(*) yantādhama yatpāṇi mudreyaṃ śodhanī bhavet||(*)(5th line) dvau hastau vaikataḥ kṛtvāmadhye tu suṣirantathā| saroja(*)mukulokārāmudreyaṃ mukulīsmṛtā||(*)(6th line) tarjanyau kuñcite caiva tayoḥ agnenidhāpayet| tvayoḥ aṃguṣṭhaśirasi śeṣāḥ jughanāḥ samāḥ|| kṛtvā tu maṇibandhau tu vāme savye tathānyaset| mudreyaṃ śaśikarṇa śati(*)vijñeyā yāgakarmaṇi||(*)(P.25b,F.2a,1st line) anyonyantaragāḥ sarvāḥ karapṛṣṭhāgrayojitāḥ| aṅguṣṭhāṅgulayaḥ kuryāt suṣiranta karāntare|(2nd line) pūjākarmagāyatriyā prayojayet| kāraṇe(—) aṅgulordhvagataṃ muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vāmena veṣṭayet|(3rd line) liṅgamudreti vikhyātā pracchinnetu pradarśayet|| karābhyāñjaliṃ kṛtvā savaktraisyādanāmike| tayoḥ agrau tu samlagnau (*)śeṣāñcā prasṛtāsmṛtāḥ||(*)(4th line) dravyamudrābhāve deṣā dravyābhāve pradarśayet| uttānau tu karau kṛtvā kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭha saṃyutam||(5th line) tarjanyānātmikā madhyaprastāśca tiryak gatau| savyāparyava savyantu vajramudrā prakīrtagatā|| tarjanī prasṛtau dīrghau daṇḍayaṃ (*)samprakīrttagatau|(*)(6th line) tarjanyāvayaścordhve pradarśayet| itarāṅguṣṭha tarjanyamitarāṅguṣṭhayogataḥ| pāśamudrābhavedeṣā (*)pāśaścede tu hetukā||(*)(7th line) uttānau tu karaukṛtvā madhyamau prasṛtau yutau| anyavaktrāḥ samāyuktā gadāvyodhaṃ prakīrttagatā||(P.26a.,F.2b,1st line) kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭha saṃyuktau ca mudrāprakīrtatā| dīpte(—) kaniṣṭhau kuñcitau caiva vāmena anyatra yatgatam| vāmāṅguṣṭha kaniṣṭhetu (*)dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitam||(*)(2nd line) tatraiva dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamitare tu vyavasthitam| deśinyanātmikā madhyetu kuñcitāścobhayorapi||(3rd line) karṇikā kalpane padmedarśayet deśikottamaḥ| uttānau tu karau kṛtvā muṣṭiṃbadhvā viśeṣataḥ||(4th line) aṅguṣṭhau prakṣipenmadhye kaniṣṭhau prasṛtau yutau| bījamudrā samākhyātā darśayet śaktikalpine|| uttānau tu (*)karau kṛtvā pāṇimūle tu bandhayet|(*)(5th line) nidhāya aṅguṣṭha śirasi tarjanyau vicakṣaṇaḥ|| anāmikāgrau (*)samlagnau samvaktrasyā viśeṣataḥ|(*)(6th line) kaniṣṭhā cocyate yuktau madhyamau prasṛtau tadau|| āsanīti samākhyātā sihmāsana vidhāviduḥ|(P.26b,F.3a,1st line) vā pradeśinyāścāgraṃ veṣṭayet dakṣiṇena tu| aṅguṣṭhamūrdhvataḥ kṛtvā hṛdayena niyojayet||(2nd line) madhyamenāmikāgre tu vāmāṅguṣṭhe nidhāpayet| prasṛtāsyāt kaniṣṭhe tu dhvajamudrā prakīrttagatā|| darśayet devasānnidhya (*)dhvajānāñcadhirohaṇe|(*)(3rd line) kṛtvā muṣṭintathottāne aṅgulyāgraviśeṣataḥ|| aṅguṣṭhāgre ca samlagnau (*)kālakarṇāyute varā|(*)(4th line) bhojadevaḥ| hastābhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā| anāmikāpavyāṅguṣṭhasamyojanenāvāhinī| (5th line) iyameḍādhomukhīsthāpinī| samlagnamuṣṭyatāṃguṣṭhī karau sannidhāni| tāveva garbhāṅguṣṭhau (6th line) sannirodhanī| mṛgendrapaddhatau(—) madhye kaniṣṭhe ca anyonyaṃ valite svatalasthite| anāmike pradeśinyau (*)saṅgatāgre vidhāya ca|(*)(P.27a.,F.3b,1st line) tanmūlaparvaṇonnasyedaṃguṣṭhāgre manorathā| dīpte(—) kṛtvānyonya gatāṃgulyaṃ pṛṣṭhatohastayo dvayoḥ|(2nd line) tiryak ca kanyaset tatra aṅguṣṭhābhyantu saṃkramet|| deśinyau madhyame yuktāpravat śrutau nāmikāyutau| iyi pañcamukhīkhyātā (*)darśayetvaktra karmaṇi||(*)(3rd line) mṛgendrabaddhatau(—) spṛṣṭe kaniṣṭe ca anyonyaṃ parasparatalā śrute| anāmike ca madhye dve (*)prasārye tvagra saṅgate||(*)(4th line) tarjanyau madhyamāpṛṣṭhe lagnau prānte ca kuñcite| aṅguṣṭhau madhyamālagnaprāntamudrāsṛgīritā||(5th line) sumukhī tarjanīyugme kuñcitannāmikā dvaye| jyeṣṭhābhyāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ krānte sṛge vāmakariḥ(reḥ) bhavet|| karayostarjanī(*)yugme nāmayugme ca pṛṣṭhataḥ|(*)(6th line) līne yugme traye śliṣṭe śūlaṃ prasārite|| kālottare(—) kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭha saṃkoce (*)śeṣañcaiva prasārayet|(*)(P.27b,F.4a,1st line) dhūpamudābhavedeṣā dīpamūdrāntataḥśruṇu|| kaniṣṭhānāmikā madhye aṅguṣṭhenatu pīḍayet|(2nd line) tarjanī mūrdhvataḥ kṛtvā dīpamudrāṃ pradarśayet|| kāraṇe(—) añjalīṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ kuñcitaṃ caturaṅgulam| puṣpavārī(*)gṛhitvā tu pādamūle pradāpayet||(*)(3rd line) cibukodakamitikhyātaṃ prajānte tu prajāpate| amśumati(—) dakṣiṇe (*)maṇibandhe ca vāmahaste tadūrdhvataḥ|(*)(4th line) madhyamādi trayaṅgulya madhyetu yojayet|| aṅguṣṭhatarjanī(*)yuktaṃ puṣpatrayaṃ vivarjayet|(*)(5th line) tat puṣpaṃvarjayitvā tu nirodhena tu mudrayā|| evaṃ visarjanī (*)mudrāśirasyañjalimācareta|(*)(6th line) suprabhede(—) kṛtvāñjalīkarābhyāntu aṅguṣṭānāmikāgrataḥ| prasārayet tataḥ (*)śeṣāmudreyandivya rūpiṇi||(*)(P.28a.,F.4b,1st line) santāne(—) karau saṃśliṣya deveśi adhomukhatathaiva ca| aṅguṣṭhatalamadhyasthāpyūrdhvaṃ (*)kṛtvā talau tathā||(*)(2nd line) udvāsyānamitiproktaṃ sarvakarmārthasādhinī| kālottare(—) uttanau karau kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhe (*)tarjanī ubhe|(*)(3rd line) śeṣāve muṣṭibadhvātu annamudrāprakīrttaśataḥ|| amśumati(—) āropya vāmahastasya kaniṣṭhānābhimaṇḍale|(4th line) tameva dakṣahastasya vāmāṅguṣṭhena yojayet|| vitatau cā karau kṛtvā dakṣāṅguṣṭhenyaset mukhe|(5th line) paridheyaṃ samākhyātāduṣṭābhārā vināśini|| uttāna śidhilaṃ muṣṭivahnādi prakṣepa udbhavaḥ|(6th line) mudreti bhojadevaḥ| suprabhede(—) pāṇimūlau tu samlagnau hṛddeśe tu parasparam| kṛtve yantāmayat (*)pāṇimudreyaṃ śodhinī bhavet||(*)(P.28b,F.5a,1st line) dvau hastāvekataḥ kṛtvā madhye tu suṣirayoḥ| sarojamukulākārā (*)mudreyaṃ mukulā smṛtā||(*)(2nd line) tarjanyau kuñcite caiva tayoḥ agre nidhāpayet| dvayoḥ aṅguṣṭhaśirasi (*)śeṣājjaṅghanāḥ samāḥ||(*)(3rd line) kṛtvā tu maṇibaṇdhe tu vāme savye tathānyeset| mudreya(…)śi karṇetī vijñeyā yāgakarṇaṇī||(4th line) anyonyantagāḥ sarvāḥ karapṛṣṭhāgrayojitāḥ| aṅguṣṭhāṅgulayaḥ kuryāt suṣirantakarānetare|| pūjākarmaṇi (*)gāyatrī gāyatriyā prayojayet|(*)(5th line) kāraṇe(—) aṅguṣṭhordhvagataṃ muṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vāmena veṣṭayet| liṅgamudreti (*)vikhyātā pṛcchanne tu pradarśayet||(*)(6th line) karābhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā savaktre sādanāmike| tayoragretu (*)samlagne śeṣāñca prasṛtāstataḥ||(*)(7th line) dravyamudrābhavedeṣā dravyabhāge pradarśayet| uttānau tu karau kṛtvā (*) kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭha saṃyutam|| (*)(P.29a.,F.5b,1st line) tarjanyānāmikā madhya prasṛtāśca tiryak gatau| savyāparyapasavyantu vajkamudrāprakīrttagatā||(2nd line) tarjanī pṛṣṭhatau dīrghau daṇḍayaṃ samprakīrttagatā| pākā dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā bāhośca calanantathā|| khaḍgamudreti vikhyātā (*)pūjādau pradarśayet|(*)(3rd line) uttānau line) grāmapradakṣiṇe kāle dhvajaṃvaiścādinā spṛśet| śokarogaṃ bhavet grāme śeṣaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam||(P. 83b,1st line) dhvajasthānaṃ samāśritya prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥ| śivāgnirjanito tatra dhvajet (*)hutvā hutvāgāyatriṇā budhaḥ||(*)(3rd line) parivārasya kuṃbheṣu chedot sandhānamācaret| taddiśāroganāśārthaṃ tanmantreṇa śataṃ (*)japet||(*)(4th line) sthāpanaṃ vṛṣayāgasya kuṃbhāt vaiśyādinā spṛśet| tat grāme canarāṇāñca śīghraṃ rogābhavanti ca|| vṛṣaśāntiṃ samāśritya (*)punassandhānaṃ ācaret|(*)(5th line) pūrvoktena vidhānena sadyena sarvamācaret || ||[iti cintye vṛṣayāgaprāyaścitta paṭalaḥ]|| (6th line) śrīkare ca tapepaitre dhvajārohaṇa hīnake| nṛpāṇāndurjayaṃ prāpya mūrttihomaṃ samācaret||(6th line) aṣṭottara śatān kuṃbhān snāpayet parameśvaram| vidhivat dhvajamāropya bharītāḍanamācaret|| dhvajaropāpare dṛṣṭvā (*)daṇḍavedyava lakṣaṇam|(*)(P. 84a,1st line) ācāryeṇa bhavet mṛtyu japet ghoraṃ sahasrakam|| daṇḍasyavedikāṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇottantu pācakam| pañcagavyena (*)samprokṣya arccayet pūīvavat sudhīḥ||(*)(2nd line) dhvajaṃ vṛṣṭikarāropo darbhamālā vihīnake| apradakṣiṇamārgeṇa daṇḍe ca rajjuṃ bandhane||(3rd line) darbhāmbara vihīne ca tasye kanyādibhi graset| rajjucchede padākāśca prāsāde gopurāṅkaṇe|| nṛpeṇa vipreṇa(*) grahe patite śuddhadeśake|(*)(4th line) tat grāme ca narāṇāñcaśoka rogabhayāvaham|| śāntihomaṃ samāśritya śiva (*)mantraṃ śataṃ japet|(*)(5th line) pañcagavyena samprokṣya dhvajamāropaṇaṃ kuru|| vaṇikaśśudrayogehe patākāpatitepi ca|(6th line) bhavanti pūrvavat doṣaṃ śānti homaṃ samācaret|| dhvajasamprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā ropayet pūrvavat sudhīḥ|(7th line) vṛkṣecaiva nadisrote samudre patitepi ca|| anyeśmaśāna bhaumādimṛtasūtā śucigrahe| patākāpatite tasmāt (*)nṛpāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ dhṛvam||(*)(P. 84b,1st line) taddoṣa śamanārthāya mūrttihomaṃ samācaret| ghaṭemekonapañcāśat kārayet parameśvaram||(2nd line) navamanyaṃ parigrāhya sadyassandhānamācaret| daṇḍā ca patite cchinne mahāvātābhavanti ca|| nṛpeṇa maraṇaṃ śīghraṃ diśāhomaṃ samācaret|(3rd line) punassandhānakaṃ kṛtvā sadyenassarvamācaret|| paścāt kuṃbhaṃ sahasrantu snāpayet parameśvaram| upadaṇḍavihīne (*)ca skandayaṣṭi vihīnake||(*)(4th line) daṇḍordhve vṛṣahīne ca āyasāvalayepi ca| hīne ca patite cchinne karttānāśona samśayaḥ||(5th line) kārayet śāntihomantu punassandhānamācaret| ghaṇṭāca patite hīne bālānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet||(6th line) puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu astramantraṃ śataṃ japet| tanmantreṇa evaṃ samprokṣya punassandhānamācaret||(7th line) skandatraye ca ghaṇḍe ca (ghaṇṭe ca) dhvajadaṇḍe dhvajepi ca | chede bhedādisaṃyuktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| dhvajāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ (*)kalpya randhrakuṃbhantu vinyaset|(*)(P. 85a,1st line) madhyame vṛṣamāvāhya āvṛte lokapālakān|| vedakuṃbhaṃ tadagretu vidhivat vinyaset (*)sudhīḥ|(*)(2nd line) viṣṇudaṇḍāt samāhūya madhyakuṃbhe suyojayet|| śrīdevī bhūmidevīñca viṣṇukuṃbhasya pāvayoḥ| kuṃbhayosthāpayet (*)cānye sthāpayetu sarasvatīm||(*)(3rd line) daṇḍordhvaṃ prāyaścittantu tattat sandhānamācaret| paścāt keśavakuṃbhantu (*)daṇḍa samprokṣaṇaṃ kuru||(*)(4th line) adhanāt bhūmidevīñca śrī devīmadhyeme ghale| snātvā sarasvatīṃ kuṃbhaṃ (*)daṇḍavedyūrdhvake sudhīḥ||(*)(5th line) vedyūrdhve daṇḍamūle ca snāpayet vṛṣakuṃbhakam| lokapālasya kuṃbhāni (*)āvṛte ca abhiṣecayet||(*)(6th line) mudgānnantu nivedyātha dhūpadīpantu dāpayet| gatāgatantu nityoktaṃ dhvaje ca vṛṣabhanyaset||(7th line) dhvaje ca vṛṣabhaṃ daṇḍe vedye ca balikāraṇam| āvāhanodvāhanā hīne pūjāhīne (*)tathaiva ca||(*)(P.85b,1st line) lyaghañca garūḍañcaiva kākadaṇḍordhvaye stuti| anyotu markaṭādīni spṛśet vaiśyādi saṃspṛśet|| śatrubhīti bhavet (*)loke gavānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet|(*)(2nd line) śāntihomaṃ samāśritya japedghoraṃ sahasrakam|| dhvajasamprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā (*)pūrvoktavidhinā budhaḥ|(3rd line) vṛṣamūlena śatañjaptavā gāyatrīñca japettataḥ|| rohaṇasyāpare dṛṣṭvā dhvajadaṇḍāvalakṣaṇaḥ| pramādantu(*) bhavet loke śilpinā nāśanaṃ bhavet||(*)(4th line) vṛṣamūle hunet sarvaṃ gāyatrīñca śataṃ hunet| lokapālena (*)mantreṇa pratyekantu śataṃ hunet||(*)(5th line) japet ghorasahasrantu mūrttihomaṃ samācaret| utsavānte viśeṣeṇa dhvajārohaṇaṃ kuru||(6th line) paścāt daṇḍasya sandhānaṃ lakṣaṇoktaṃ samācaret| śatāṣṭakalaśañcaiva snāpayet (*)parameśvaram||(*)(7th line) mūrttihomaṃ samāśritya daṇḍaṃ samprokṣaṇaṃ kuru| ||[iti cintye pratiṣṭhātantre dhvajārohaṇaprāyaścitta paṭalaḥ]|| (P.86a,1st line) (side heading)[bharītāḍana prāyaścittam] bherītāḍanahīne ca utsave niṣpalaṃ bhavet| grāme ca vardhate mūghaṃ(?) śāntihomaṃ samācaret||(2nd line) nandimantrasahasrañca bherītāḍanamācaret| koṇechede ca patite ghoṣakāle ca bherikā|| carme ca saptakīle ca (*)hīneśyanti vādyakā|(*)(3rd line) astraṇaiva śatañjaptvā nandimantraṃ śataṃ japet|| navamanyaṃ parigrāhya vidhivat tāḍayet sudhīḥ|(4th line) vadake patite bhūmau tatkāle balikālake|| bhavet dustitaṃ grāme nandimantraṃ śataṃ hunet| dinaṃ prati purāstasya carmakīlokta bherikā||(5th line) tat kālettāḍayet devīṃ grāme mūghaṃ prasannatam| śāntihomaṃ samāśritya japet carmādi kīlake||(6th line) navamanyaṃ parigrāhya lakṣaṇoktantu bandhayet | nandimantraṃ sahasrañca bherīntu tāḍayet sudhīḥ|| pūjāhīne mahābherīṃ sthānaśobhāvinaśyati|(7th line) nandimantraṃ śatañjaptvā prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥ|| dviguṇaṃ haviṣaṃ dadyāt astramantraṃ śatañjapet|(P. 86b,1st line) śātānta mūṣikādī ca chinne randhre ca carmayet|| vādyakasya bhavet mṛtyughoramantraṃ śatañjapet| nandimantraṃ śataṃ hutvā (*)nassandhānamācaret||(*)(2nd line) pañcagavyena samprokṣya pūrvavat yajanaṃ kurū| ||[iti cintye bherītāḍanaprāyaścitta paṭalaḥ]|| (side heading)[kautukabandhana prāyaścittam](3rd line) utsave devadevāya hine kautukabandhanam| nṛpāṇāṃ buddhisantāpaṃ jāyate rāṣṭravidrumam|| taddoṣaśamanārthāya (*)mūrttihomaṃ samācaret|(*)(4th line) pūrvoktena vidhānena bandhayet kautukaṃ sudhīḥ|| hastat pratisaraṃ raupyaṃ (*)naṣṭe karttṛvināśanam|(*)(5th line) mūrttihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punassandhānamācareta|| kautuketvaiva viprendra sadyassamprokṣaṇaṃ kuru|(6th line) chinne śalpadatantasmāt śāntihomaṃ samācaret|| punasandhānakaṃ kṛtvā hṛdayenaśataṃ japet|(7th line) ||[iti kautukabandha prāyaścitta paṭalaḥ]|| yāgapūjāvihīne ca utsavaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet| naśyanti rājārāṣṭrañca (*)mūrttihomaṃ samācaret||(*)(P.87a,1st line) aṣṭottaraśatān kuṃbhān snāpayet parameśvaram| śivamantraṃ sahasrañca punarutsavamārabhet||(2nd line) yāgapūjākrameṇaiva ācaret deśikottamaḥ| yāgamaṇḍapa hīne ca vedihīne na lakṣaṇe|| bhavedusthiti sugrāme (*)kṛtvā lakṣaṇa saṃyutam|(*)(3rd line) śānti homaṃ samāśritya prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥ|| pūrvokta vidhānena tattat karmaṃ samācaret|(4th line) uṣṇīya sthaṇḍalaṃ kṣiptvā vedyekuṃbhaṃ praśesati|| dhānya nāśaṃbhavet grāme vidhināsthaṇḍilaṃ kṣepet| pañcagavyena saṃprokṣya (*)sthāpitā ca ghaṭān kramāt||(*)(5th line) sthāpitā ca ghaṭoktantu yāgaśālāṃ nirdaṇḍake| nṛpasya maraṇaṃ śīghraṃ rāṣṭre cāgni(*)bhayaṃ bhavet||(*)(6th line) sarvāṅgārāṇi udvāsya punassandhānamācaret| devadevasya viprendra kṣīradhārābhiṣecayet||(7th line) śatāṣṭakalaśaṃ snātvā punarutsavamārabhet| kevalaṃ agninā dagdhe pūrvavat maṇḍapaṃ kuru|| grāme ca agni bhayaṃ śātāt śāntihomaṃ samācaret|(P. 87b,1st line) pañcagavyena samprokṣya śivamantraṃ śataṃhunet|| dvāratoraṇahīne ca sthāneśatru bhayaṃ bhavet| tanmantreṇa śatañjaptvā astra(*)mantraṃ śataṃ hunet||(*)(2nd line) puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu punassandhānamācaret| darbhamālāvihīne ca grāme sarpabhayaṃ bhavet|| astramantraṃ (*)śataṃ hutvā tattat sandhānamācaret|(*)(3rd line) aṣṭamaṅgalahīne ca rāṣṭremaṅgalahīnakam|| kṛtvācāt bhūtaśāntiñca prokṣayet (*)pañcagavyakam|(*)(4th line) tattat sandhānakaṃ kṛtvā śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet|| maṇḍapārādhanaṃ hīne roka śoka bhayaṃ nṛṇām|(5th line) samhitāhomaṃ āśritya maṇḍapaṃ pūjayet sudhīḥ|| hutvāmūlaṃ sahasrañca parivāre śataṃ hunet| astramantreṇa viprendra (*)hutvā japtvā śataṃ hunet||(*)(6th line) vedyāḥ pradhānakuṃbhantu chinne chinne ca nirjale| nṛpāyamaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ mūrttihomaṃ samācaret||(7th line) aṣṭottaraśatān kuṃbhān snāpayet parameśvaram| navamanyaṃ parigrāhya vidhivat sthāpayet sudhīḥ|| mūlenaiva sahasrañca śivamantrañjapet tataḥ|(P.88a,1st line) yāgasya vardhanīṃ paścāt āvṛtāṣṭa ghaṭepi ca|| pāśupadāstraṃ kuṃbhau ca chinne randhre ca nirjale| nṛpastrīṇāñca mantrīṇāṃ (*)sadyomaraṇamāpnuyāt||(*)(2nd line) bhinna kuṃbhantu saṃsthāpya tanmūlena śataṃ hunet| śāntihomantataḥ kṛtvā śivamūlaṃ śataṃ hunet|| tat saṅkhyā ca (*)hane vipra astreṇaiva tu mantrataḥ|(*)(3rd line) yāgasya maṇḍapebhyarcya aṣṭāviṃśati kuṃbhake|| bhinne ca nirjale caiva tadedeśarāṣṭravibhramam| puṇyāhaṃ (*)vācayettatra sthāpayet hīna kuṃbhakam||(*)(4th line) tanmūlena śataṃ japtvā śivamūle śataṃ hunet| yāgārādhana kuṃbheṣu ratnahema vihīnake||(5th line) kūrcapuṣpavihīne ca nīlikera vihīnake| āmrapatra vihīne ca tantuveṣṭa vihīnake||(6th line) vastraveṣṭa vihīne ca nṛpasya śokasaṃbhavam| caturaṅgāya viprendra śīghraṃ maraṇamāpnuyāt|| śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā (*)tattat sandhānaṃ ācaret|(*)(7th line) tanmūle hunet sahasraṃ japet pañcasahasrakam|| śatāṣṭakalaśañcaiva snāpayet parameśvaram|(P. 88b,1st line) śivagāyatrimantreṇa hutvā japtvā sahasrakam|| vedyāṃkuṃbheṣu homañca nālikerañca vastrakam| naṣṭe ca dīkṣitāñcaiva (*)śūdrādi sparśane sati||(*)(2nd line) nṛparāṣṭrantu nāśaṃ syāt punassandhānamācaret| mūrttihomaṃ samāśritya śūlasya navakaṃ kurū||(3rd line) śivamūlaṃ hunet sahasrantat saṅkhyā ca sadāśivam| parivāreṇa viprendra pratyekantu śataṃ hunet || kuṃbhantu nālikerantu bhinne ca nirjale'pi ca|(4th line) śirorogaṃ bhavet grāmeśānti homaṃṃ samācaret|| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā (*)tu nyastvā anya nālikerakam|(*)(5th line) tanmūle japet sahasraṃ (*)śiromantraṃ śataṃ hunet||(*)(6th line) triśūlārādhanāhīne lokeśāstra bhayaṃ bhavet|(7th line) snapanaṃ kārayet śaṃbho astreṇa snapanaṃ kurū|| śivamantraṃ śatañjaptvā astramantraṃ śataṃ hunet|(8th line) agnikāryavihīne ca niṣpalaṃ śivayāgakam|| nṛpeṇamaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ loke cāgnibhayaṃ bhavet| taddoṣaśamanārthāya (*)samhitāhomaṃ ācaret||(*)(P.89a,1st line) adhikaṃ vedavahniñca pañcāgnetu satamācaret| bhuktimukti bhavet vipranyūne doṣantu pūrvavat||(2nd line) kuṇḍahīne na lakṣaṇye bhinne chinne tathaiva ca| karttṛnāśaṃ bhavet śāntāt lakṣaṇoktantu kārayet|| mūrttihomaṃ samāśritya (*)nidhāyāgnintu pūrvavat|(*)(3rd line) brahmakūrcavihīne ca deśikasya mṛtirbhavet|| bhuktvā cādbhutaśāntiñca brahmakūrcantu vinyaset|(4th line) brahmamantraṃ śatañjaptvā astramantraṃ śatañjapet|| praṇicalite hīne varṣadurbhikṣamāpnuyāt| śāntihomaṃ samāśritya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ||(5th line) praṇītāṃ vinyaset mantrāt viṣṇumantraṃ śatañḍapet| darbhāparidhīhīne ca sṛksṛvau (*)ca vihīnake||(*)(6th line) grāmaśrītvanyathācaiva śāntihomaṃ samācaret| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu tattat sandhānamācaret||(7th line) homadravyavihīne ca durbhikṣāṃ jāyate dhṛvam| śāntihomaṃ samāśritya śivamūleśataṃ hunet|| sadyādi śāstraparyantaṃ (*)mantraṃ mekādaśepi ca|(*)(P. 89b,1st line) dravyaṃ prativiśeṣeṇa kramāt hutvā śataṃ hunet|| agnidaṇḍeṣu vicchede kukṣirogaṃ bhayaṃ nṛṇām| udvāsyaṅgāni (*)bhasmānāṃ nidhāyāgnintu pūrvavat||(*)(2nd line) śivamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā sādākhyantu sahasrakam| mantrahīne kriyāhīne rājārāṣṭrantu nāśanam||(3rd line) mūrttihomaṃ samāśritya hutvā mūlaṃ sahasrakam| śivamūlaṃ śataṃ hutvā gāyatrīñca hunettataḥ|| yāgadīpavihīne ca netrarogaṃ bhavenṛṇām|(4th line) dīpamāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā astramantraṃ śataṃ hunet|| ||[iti cintye yāgamaṇḍapa prāyaścitta paṭalaḥ]|| (side heading)[balidāna prāyaścittam] halidānavihīne ca (*)śivayāgantu niṣphalam|(*)(5th line) kṣudrabhūtamahābādhā bhavet grāmamanuṣyayoḥ|| mūrttihomaṃ samāśritya punarutsavamācaret|(6th line) utsave balidānantu ekasandhivihīnake|| tat grāmavāsināḥ sarve jāyate kukṣirogakam| pañcagavyena samprokṣa (*)dinadevā śataṃ japet||(*)(7th line) pūrvokta vidhinānena yānāntabalimācaret| balihīne ahorātraṃ kṣutbādhāṃ jāyatenṛṇām||(P. 90a,1st line) mūrttihomaṃ samāśritya hutvāmūlaṃ sahaskam| śatāṣṭakalaśaṃ snātvā japtvāghoraṃ sahasrakam|| ardhenduśekharañcaiva snāpayet snapanantataḥ|(2nd line) pañcagavyena samprokṣya sadyenaḥ sarvamācaret|| vudvayāhe balihīne ca nṛpasya maraṇaṃ dhṛvam| diśāhomaṃ samāśritya hunet pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ||(3rd line) yāgakuṃbhantu samsthāpya punaryāgaṃ samācaret| bherītāḍanamādīnī punarutsavamācaret|| mahāvṛṣṭibhavet vāstu (*)prākāre pralayesati|(*)(4th line) paracakāt bhayaṃ bhūmau mūrttihomaṃ samācaret|| grāmaprākāra kendrāgre vāstubrahmābaliṃ kṣipet|(5th line) vāstau tu lokapālānāṃ yāme dikpālabāhyayoḥ|| bhaumau tu bali nikṣiptvā pūrvoktavidhinā sudhīḥ|(6th line) pralayantu gatepaścāt śāntihomaṃ samācaret|| dikpālādhipamantreṇa pratyekantu śataṃ hunet| vāstuprākārayeddevī (*)pūrvavat balimācaret||(*)(7th line) pūrvavat guṇadoṣañca vithyeke pralaye sati| tattayoḥ devayau gaurī (*)jalānte balisaṃkṣipet||(*)(P.90b,1st line) athavā brahmasūtrasya vīthye ca balimācaret| tat pūrveśāntihomañca kṛtvā hutvā śataṃ śivam|| pādukantuvihīne ca (*)naṣṭecchinne tathaiva ca| (*)(2nd line) pādarogaṃ bhavet grāme punassandhānamācaret|| pañcagavyena samprokṣya śāntihomaṃ samācaret|(3rd line) balikālenyasandhya tu pādukantu samācaret|| patide pādukañcaiva prokṣayet pañcagavyakam|(4th line) japedghoraṃ sahasraṃ baliṃ śeṣaṃ samācaret|| balikālenyasandhayau tu pādukantu samācaret| balyarthaṃ yānakāle (*)tu vṛṣadhvaja vihīnake|(*)(5th line) chatre ca cāmarāhīne śokaroga bhavenṛṇām|| aghoreṇaśataṃ japtvā tattat sandhānamācaret|(6th line) balidīpavihīne ca grāme jyeṣṭhā ca vāsinam|| aghoreṇaśataṃ japtvā dviguṇaṃ dīpamācaret| (7th line) gopuradvāra deśe tu śaṅkhaghoṣa vihīnake|| rākṣasenāñcaret grāmeśānti homaṃ samācaret| ghaṇṭāravavihīne (*)ca pūrvavaddoṣayo bhavet||(*)(P.91a,1st line) astramantraṃ sahasrañca ghaṇṭārava samanvitam| tāḍayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ| vādyakaṃ (*)tāḍayet paścāt balitāle viśeṣataḥ||(*)(4th line) paścāt ślokena sarveṣāṃ śrāvayedutsavāntakam| astreśamānayet (*)pūrvaṃ sarvāto'dyasamāyuktam||(*)(5th line) yāmapraveśanaṃ kuryāt devasyāgre sthatobudhaḥ| devasya devatāhvānaṃ sannivedya sacotsavam||(6th line) baliberasamāyuktaṃ sarvato'dyasamāyutam| vṛṣādiparivārāṇāṃ balindadyāt svanāmataḥ||(7th line) indrādīśānaparyantaṃ nityavatsarvamācaret| brahmasthānādikaṃ vātha indrasthānādikantuvā|| sandhidevān samāvāhya balimevaṃ samācaret|(P.128,a1st line) evamāvāhya devāśca praviśet ālayaṃ prati|| vijayasyakramaṃ proktaṃ vṛddhikañca tataḥ śruṇu| astraṃ bherīñca sampūjya pūrvoktavidhinā saha||(2nd line) carcapuṭena tālena vādayet sarvatālayit| śivādisarvadevāṃśca āhūyābhyarcyate kramāt|| astrarājaṃ samādāya sarva(*)to'dya samanvitam|(*)(3rd line) devālaye pratijñāta balidānaṃ samācaret|| sthāna saṅkaṭadhāmeṣu prākārādi viśeṣataḥ| labhyate yatradeśetu (*)balintatra prakalpayet||(*)(4th line) pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā praviśedālayaṃ prati| deveśaṃ pūjayet tatra (*)nityapūjāvidhānataḥ||(*)(5th line) bherītāḍanamevoktaṃ astrayāgavidhiṃ śruṇu| raverastamayāt pūrvenirddiṣṭa (*)divasettataḥ||(*)(6th line) vāstuhomaṃ purākṛtvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ kurū| tatoṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt utsavārthaṃ yathākramam||(7th line) kautukaṃ bandhayet dhīmān maheśāgre viśeṣataḥ| śālibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ|| sthalikāṃ taṇḍulaiḥ pūryadarbhaiḥ (*)puṣpaiḥ samanvitam|(*)(P.128b,1st line) kramukaṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ nāgavallīdalairyutam|| bhasmānāṃ dhānyasenmadhye kautukaṃ vinyasettataḥ| sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃvāpi (*)kṣaumakārpāsantu vā||(*)(2nd line) navāmbarasamāyuktaṃ gandhamālāsamanvitam| sthaṇḍilordhve tu vinyasya rakṣāsūtramanujapet||(3rd line) paścāt saṃsnāpya yāgeśaṃ gandhatoyena deśikaḥ| abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ dhūpadīpādi(*)kandadet||(*)(4th line) yuvaṃ vastretimantreṇa vastreṇācchādayet prabhoḥ| tryambakena mantreṇa sūtraṃ saṃsicya bhasmanā|| taṇḍulaṃ dāpayeddhaste (*)onnamo brahmaṇetyapi|(*)(5th line) devasya dakṣiṇe haste devyā vāmakare budhaḥ|| bṛhatsāmetimantreṇa (*)kautukaṃ bandhayeddhṛdā|(*)(6th line) yau brahmaṇādimantreṇa bhasitandāpayettataḥ|| pūrvākṣatena viprāṇāmāśiṣo (*)vācamabṛvan|(*)(P.129a,1st line) śūlasyamadhyapatre tu balyarthaṃ kautukaṃ vinā|| utsavoddiśyadevānāṃ kautukaṃ bandhayettataḥ| bhasmasya pūrvadigbhāge (*)aiśānye cottarepivā||(*)(3rd line) pūrvoktalakṣaṇopetaṃ kārayedyāgamaṇḍapam| gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā piṣṭasiktena tantunā||(4th line) prāgagraṃ daśasūtrāṇi udagagraṃ tathaiva ca| yāgaśālāṃ praviśyātha sakalīkaraṇaṃ kurū|| puṇyāhaṃ vācayet (*)tatra prokṣayedyāgamaṇḍapam|(*)(5th line) saurādiguruparyantaṃ maṇḍapaṃ samprapūjayet|| vedyūrdhve sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā(*)cāṣṭadroṇaiśca śālinā|(*)(6th line) taṇḍulaiḥ tilalājaiśca darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaret|| navakuṃbhān samādāya (*)tantunā pariveṣṭayet|(*)(7th line) kṣālayedastramantreṇa pūrayet śuddhavāriṇā|| sakūrcān pallavopetān nālikeraphalānvitān|(P.129b,1st line) ratnān vastra saṃyuktān sthāpayet vedikopari|| madhyamepyutsavādhīśaṃ tasya vāme manonmanīm|(2nd line) pūrvādīnyaṣṭakuṃbheṣu vidyeśān samprapūjayet|| daśāyudhāni paritaḥpūjayet kuṃbhavarjitam| tat bāhye pūjayet (*)vidvānnabhitaścāṣṭamaṅgalam||(*)(3rd line) tattat svanāmamantreṇa gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet| vidhinā kuṇḍasamskāraṃ kṛtvāgniṃ samprakalpayet||(4th line) samidājyacarūṃ lājaṃ māṣaśālīyavantilam| sarvādiśikhaparyantaṃ pratyekaṃ homamācaret|| śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā navapañcaikamevavā|(5th line) dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutimathācaret|| naivedyaṃ dāpayet tasmāt dhūpadīpādikandadet|(6th line) astrayāgamidaṃ proktaṃ balidānakramaṃ śruṇu|| homāntetu balindadyāt sāyamprātaḥ krameṇa tu| droṇaṃ vā pita(*)dardhaṃ vā balyarthaṃ taṇḍulaṃ pacet||(*)(P.130a,1st line) kaṭāhaṃ sthalikāṃ vāpi kṣālayet puruśaṣeṇa tu| tatpātre nikṣipedantaṃ balidravyasamāyutam||(2nd line) pācayedantaliṅgārthaṃ taṇḍulaṃ pātrasaṅkhyakam| sthalikābhyantare kṣiptvā phalodadhisamāyutam|| dvādaśāṅgulaṃ utsedhaṃ (*)tannāhaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet|(*)(3rd line) agramagnyaṅgulaṃ proktaṃ māmūlāgraṃ kramātkuśam|| liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tu tat śeṣa(*)mannaṃ aphsavinikṣipet|(*)(4th line) talliṅgasyatu madhye tu raudraṃ pāśupadaṃ yajet|| tatolaṅkṛtamāhūya vastrapuṣpaisṛgādikam|(5th line) grāhayitvā viśeṣajña tatogarbhagṛhantataḥ|| devadevāya vijñāpya balidānaṃ samantrakam| kuryāt pañcamahāśabdaṃ balitālasamanvitam|| (6th line) astreśamannaliṅgañca baliberasamanvitam| chatracāmara saṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭārava samanvitam||(P.130b,1st line) sarvavādya samāyuktaṃ gaṇikādibhirāvṛtam| balidīpa samāyuktaṃ balipātrasamanvitam|| svastisūkta samāyuktaṃ balindatvā vicakṣaṇaḥ|(2nd line) nandikālau vṛṣaścaiva bhānumuṇḍinīmātaraḥ|| vīrabhadrogaṇeśaśca vighneśañcācyutaṃ guham| durgācaṇḍeśvaraścaiva (*)prathamāvaraṇe yajet||(*)(3rd line) dvitīyāvaraṇecaiva daṇḍibhṛṅgi vṛṣadhvajam| mahāpīṭhaṃ vṛṣaṃ śūlaṃ triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇam||4th line mahāpīṭhāgrake devarājānāṃ balimācaret| agnirvaivasvato sṛkpaḥ apāṃ patiścamārutam||(5th line) yakṣeśaḥ kṣetravālañca īśoviṣṇuḥ viriñcakam| dvitīyāvaraṇantvevaṃ praviśya nagarādikam||(6th line) prāsādāt nirgamadvāraṃ deśedvārabalindadet| praveśasyoktare bhāge kuryāt kuṃbhodaraṃ balim|| tasya dakṣiṇabhāgetu (*)balindatvā mahodaram|(*)(7th line) dvayoḥ madhye mahāvegibalindatvā viśeṣataḥ|| brahmasthānādito vāpi (*)indrasthānāditaḥ kramāt|(*)(P.131a,1st line) iṣṭakāṃ vā mṛdāṃ vā vikārayet balipīṭhakam|| gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā prokṣayet pañcagavyakaiḥ| jvālājihvā(*)jvalatkeśa mahākoso mahābala||(*)(2nd line) martyāśanaḥ ścaṇḍavego vāstupālo balipriyaḥ| mahābhūtaśca vijñeyā brahmasthānāditaḥ kramāt||(3rd line) pūrvaṃ tyaktvā athadevāṃśca indrasthānādito balim| evaṃ bhūtabaliṃ datvā grāmaśānti karaṃ bhavet|| pīṭhāgre (*)gopurāgre vā aiśānye pīṭhavāmataḥ|(*)(4th line) dinadevabaliṃ dadyāt dinaṃ prati balidvanam(?)|| sarvadevāśca ptyarthaṃ mīśestrāyabalindadet| (5th line) ṣoḍaśaivopacāreṇa balindatvā vicakṣaṇaḥ|| pādyamācanañcārghyaṃ gandhaṃ puṣpañca dhūpakam|(6th line) dīpaṃ balipradānañca balimudrāṃ pradarśanam|| arghyadānaṃ namaskāra stotraṃ vai bherīghoṣaṇam|(7th line) nṛttaṃ saṅgītavādyañca balipīṭhaṃ prati prati|| megharājābja varttañca brahmatālasamanvitam| gānaṃmalagirīryuktaṃ brahmadeśe priyārthakam||(P.131b,1st line) (…)ṇdhārasvara saṃyuktaṃ puṣpāñjalistu(…)| rāṭīstvīndradeśetu devatā prītikāraṇam|| kollīsvarasamāyuktaṃ pratyālīḍiñca maṭṭayam|(2nd line) pravālagirigānañca agnideśe priyārthakam|| naṭṭabhāṣā bhujaṅgañca tālañca puṭantathā| vasantagāna saṃyuktaṃ yāmyadeśe (*)priyārthakam||(*)(3rd line) kauśikaṃ maṅgalāvarttamekatālasamanvitam| gānandeśāgirirryuktaṃ naiṝdeśe priyārthakam|| śrīkāmaraṃ svasāvarttaṃ tālañcācapuṭantathā|(4th line) gānaṃ somagiriryutaṃ vāruṇyāṃ diśimācaret|| takkeśi bhujagālīḍhaṃ balitāla samanvitam|(5th line) gānaṃ mālavasaṃyuktaṃ vāyudeśe priyārthakam|| pañcamotghaṭṭitañcaiva kuṃbhatāla samanvitam|(6th line) śuddhagauḍhasamāyuktaṃ saumyadeśepriyārthakam|| evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praviśet ālayaṃ prati| pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā mahāpīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet||(7th line) yāmapradakṣiṇavaśāt praviśet devamaṇḍapam| nīrāñjanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā baliberasya deśikaḥ|| annaliṅgaṃ jalekṣiptvā cāstreśaṃ (*)yāgamaṇḍape|(*)(P.132a,1st line) puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ datvā mūlaberasya sannidhau|| pūrvoktavidhinā anena sandhyāśeṣaṃ samācaret| tataḥ sandhyāvasāne tu sakaleśvaramalaṅkṛtam||(2nd line) raṅge vā śibikoyāṃ vā kheṭakeropayettataḥ| vīthi samārjanaṃ kṛtvā jalenaiva tu secayet||(3rd line) kadalīkramukaiśceva saphalaiḥ pūrṇakuṃbhakaiḥ| citravastrañca gandhañca kantu himatoyakam|| darpaṇaṃ keśaśoñca kṛṣṇagandhañca sāñjanam|(4th line) uśīraṃ giriberañca kalhāraṃ jāti campakam|| nālikera samāyuktaṃ tāmbūlaṃ kramukantathā|(5th line) śatapatrañca dīpañca gṛhadvāraṃ prati prati|| nānā dīpasamāyuktaṃ nānā bhaktajanairyutam| nānāchatrasamāyuktaṃ (*)nānā dhvajasamanvitam||(*)(6th line) nāna vādyasamāyuktaṃ nānāstrī parisevitam| cāmarantālavrantañca dāsikaiśca pradāpayet||(7th line) mahāśaivāsmadante ca tadante bhūsurāstathā| tadante rudragaṇikāḥ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam|| tadante vāhanārūḍhāḥ (*)tadante vādyaghoṣakān|(*)(P.132b,1st line) sarvālaṅkāra saṃyuktaṃ sarvatodya samāyutam|| grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praviśyāsthānamaṇḍape|(2nd line) sihmāsanesamāropya vādyanedatvā vicakṣaṇaḥ|| gaṇḍūṣārthañjalaṃ deyaṃ karasampūrṇamānataḥ| eka(-)tri(-)pañcavāraṃ(*)vā visṛjedastramantrataḥ||(*)(3rd line) bhūmiśuddhintataḥ kṛtvā nālikeraphalādikam| nivedayitadevāya pānīyaṃ (*)dāpayet tataḥ||(*)(4th line) tāmbūlandāpayet vidvān karpūreṇa samanvitam| karpūraśakalenaiva dhūpānte (*)dīpamācaret||(*)(5th line) nīrāñjanaṃ prakurvita sarvaprāṇihitāya vai| śuddhanṛttāvasāne tu bahurūpaṃ samācaret||(6th line) citrālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ maddāsībhiḥ prakalpayet| nānā deśakathā vādyaidharma yuddhādi darśanaiḥ|| vinodavā(*)kyairanyaiḥ ca mahājālādidarśanaiḥ|(*)(7th line) vīṇāveṇu mṛdaṅgādi vādyaiḥ anyāścaśobhitaiḥ|| ācāryassavyabhāge tu (*)svāsīno vāmakenṛpaḥ|(*)(P.133a,1st line) tayoḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ pradeśetu śiṣyantutyāśca samsthitau|| mardakonarttakaścaiva vāmabhāge tu (*)samsthitaḥ|(*)(2nd line) pārśvayorūbhayoścaiva rudrasyagaṇikāsthitāḥ|| śeṣabhakta (*)janāḥ sarvevāmabhāgetu samsathitāḥ|(*)(3rd line) maheśāgre viśeṣaṇa bahurūpaṃ samācaret| gītavādyādibhiḥ sarvaistotraistu (*)vā maheśvaram||(*)(4th line) gandhamālyāvarohañca snānavedyoparinnyaset| snapanaisnāpayet vidvān śuddhānnañca nivedayet||(5th line) tato devaṃsamādāya svastisūktasamanvitam| dhāmapraveśanaṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhaghoṣa samanvitam||(6th line) dhāmāgre cottarevātha dakṣiṇe paścimethavā| gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā piṣṭacūrṇaivicitrayet||(7th line) madhyame vinyaset evaṃ dinabera samanvitam| pādyadravyādikān sarvān paraddivasocitān||(P.133b,1st line) dravyāṇyāhūya devāgre sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥ| pādmācamanīyārghya snānārthaṃ dravyamaindrakaiḥ|| vastraṃ vilepanaṃ (*)dravyaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇe diśi|(*)(2nd line) dhūpādyārātrikaṃ dravyaṃ paścime diśivinyaset|| uttare mukhavāsañca pānīyaṃ dravyasaṃyutam|(3rd line) pāvake vinyaset dhīmān naivādyārthañca taṇḍulam|| marīcī lavaṇaṃ hiṅgu jīrakaṃ sepadamśakam| vinyase (*)naiṛte bhāge vāyavye chatracāmaram||(*)(4th line) chinnavastraṃ satailañca dīpadaṇḍantathaiśake| anyāni sarvadravyāṇi devāgre(*)hanyasettataḥ||(*)(5th line) puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra dravyādhivāsanārthakam| praṇavena samabhyarcya amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kurū|| itthaṃ yāgopa(*)karaṇaṃ sarvandhāmapravaśeyet|(*)(6th line) dhāmapraveśanasyānte nānālaṅkārasaṃyutam|| utasave śamalaṃ kṛtya sugandhakusumādibhiḥ|(7th line) śibikādau samāropya bhavānyālayamāviśet|| alaṅkṛtya vitānādyairālayaṃ śayanārhakam| tanmadhye śayanaṃ (*)kalpamudrapuṣpasamanvitam||(*)(P.134a,1st line) tasyordhve vastramāntīrya sthāpayet prāṅmukhaṃ vibhum| tasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu gaurīṃ (*)sampūjayet gurūm||(*)(2nd line) saptamā triguṇaṃ pūrve rohiṇī gaṇamuttare| guhyamātrigaṇandakṣe paścime viṣṇu mātarau|| brāhma(*)mātriguṇantvīśe pāvake madanaṃ ratim|(*)(3rd line) vasanta naiṛtedeśe nakṣatreśañca vāyave|| pādukaṃ rājacihnañca (*)pūrvādīnī pradakṣiṇam|(*)(4th line) vastroparinyaset vidvān tattanamantraissamarcayet|| naivedyaṃ dāpayet tatra yathā(*)bhaktasamanvitam|(*)(5th line) dhūpadīpantato datvā tāmabūlaṃ dāpayettataḥ|| daśāstraṃ paritobhyarcya kavacena tu rakṣayet|(6th line) vastreṇa sā vidhānañca kuryāt kavāṭabandhanam|| rātryāntake gurūsnātvā kuśalaiḥ pariyaṣṭibhiḥ| sandhyādivandanaṃ kṛtvā (*)praviśeddevamandiram||(*)(P. 134b,1st line) tato'ntaryajanaṃ kṛtvā pariyaṣṭihimañcitam| śakanyālaṃ samāveśyakapāṭot ghāṭanaṃ kurū||(2nd line) pracchannapaṭamāvarjya praṇamya sakaleśvaram| oṃ namo devadeveśassarvalokaikanāyaka|| uttiṣaṭha snānakarmārthaṃ sarvalokābhivṛddhaye|(3rd line) ityuktā devamādāya pūrvaśakti samanvitam|| śibikādau samāropya sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam|(4th line) grāmaṃ vā nilayaṃ vātha pradakṣiṇamathācaret|| āsthānamaṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā pūjāparyūṣitaṃ kramāt|(5th line) samāpyagandhatailādyaiḥ piṣṭāmalakacandanaiḥ|| pañcagavyāmṛtaiḥ antyenālikeraphalādikaiḥ| snāpayeddevadevaśaṃ (*)snapanena tu deśikaḥ||(*)(6th line) tadante koṣṭhakastūri kuṅkumaisnāpayet vibhum| tataḥ sammārjyavastreṇa kaupīnādyaṃ visarjayet||(7th line) śuddhavastreṇa samveṣṭya nayedyāgārtha maṇḍape| vedyūrdhve dakṣiṇepārśve uttarevā viśeṣataḥ||(P.135a,1st line) padmāsanesamāropya pūjayet kalaśādikam| pādyamācamanañcārghyaṃ dinayuktāmbrādibhiḥ|| havirnivedayet vidvān bhaktyārājopacāravat|(2nd line) śivāgneryajanaṃ kuryādinādhipati bījakam|| pūrvoktavidhinānena yāgahomaṃ samācaret| hutvānte (*)dhūpadīpādaistoṣayet sakaleśvaram||(*)(3rd line) ayudhānyarcayet tatra aiśānyāṃ vedikopari| tattat svanāmamantreṇa dinadevādhibījakam||(4th line) gandhapuṣpākṣate devīpūjayet devasannidhau| tato vedādikaṃ stotraṃ gīta nṛttañca vādyakam|| bhasmanā tilakandatvā (*)viprāśīrvacanaiḥ saha|(*)(5th line) deveśāgre prakarttavyaṃ baliṃ vijñāpayet budhaḥ|| tatostrarājamādāya baliberasamanvitam|(6th line) annaliṅgasamopetaṃ ghaṇaṭāvasamanvitam|| chatracāmarasaṃyuktaṃ nānā dīpasamanvitam| balidānasamopetaṃ pradakṣiṇamathācaret||(7th line) balyante cotsavaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutam| prabhāmadhye sthitodevaratna sihmāsane'pi ca|| pādyamācamanārghyasyāt phala(*)bhakṣyādikaṃ dadet|(*)(P.135b,1st line) dhūpadīpādikaṃ datvā saukhyasyā lokanaṃ kurū|| atha madhyāhnavelāyāṃ sakaleśayajet tataḥ|(2nd line) yātrārthaṃ snapanaṃ kṛtvā nivedya taṃ samarcayet|| mūlaberārcanaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā nayet| prāsādaseyottare caindre (*)paścime vā vaśeṣataḥ||(*)(3rd line) āsthānamaṇḍape vātha naimittikārcanaṃ caret| bhūyo'pi samalaṅkṛtya sakaleśamalaṃ kṛtam|| vinodālokanā(*)rthāya sāyāhnasyā parārdhake|(*)(4th line) grāmapradakṣinaṃ kṛtvā pariveṣa kramānvitam|| ajasūkarayuddhaṃ (*)vā malyuddhaṃ athāpivā|(*)(5th line) yeṇa śārdūlayuddhaṃ vā ajaśārdūlameva vā|| samakukkuṭayuddhaṃ vā śvāna(*)sūkarameva vā|(*)(6th line) śvānenaśaśapuñjairvyāghreṇa śvākulaihyavā|| gajamānavasarvairvā vinodārthaṃ prakalpayet|(7th line) anyonyāneka jātāni vinodāni pradarśayet|| sabhāmaṇḍapasamāsādya dhūpadīpaṃ samācaret| nīrāñjanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā (*)sāyarakṣāvidhānataḥ||(*)(P.136a,1st line) bhūyo'pi snāpayet vidvān snapanādyaiḥ maheśvaram| havirnivedayet tatra yāgahomaṃ samācaret||(2nd line) ca|(P.137b, 1st line) sphaṭikantu pugomedaṃ drujataṃ padmabījakam|| svarṇābharaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ vaiḍūryañca pravālakam| mauttikañcaiva rudrākṣaṃ (*)māṇikkañcaindranīlakam||(*)(2nd line) puṣyarāgakrameṇaiva śriyāvarttaṃ punnāga(*)ñcaturaṅgulam|(*)(4th line) mallikāmālatīcaiva mandāraprabhṛtīntathā|| vakulaṃ padmapuṣpañca karavīrantathaiva ca| jātaśvetārka (*)cāmpeya pāṭalyutpalameva ca||(*)(5th line) droṇapuṣpañca vighneśa dīśāntaṃ samprakalpayet| priyānanda priyāmodaṃ (*)viśvapriyamanoramam||(*)(6th line) śrīkāmadaṃ tu iti proṣaṃ(ktaṃ) madānāṃ kuru dhūpakam| arciṣyanyaṅga dhūpañca bhogānnañca phalodakam| rājānnañcaiva (*)muktānnaṃ śyāmānnaṃ kṛsarānnakam||(*)(4th line) kṣīrānnañcaiva śuddhānnaṃ mudgānnañca gulodanam| piṣṭānnaṃ caiva hāridraṃ (*)kantvannaṃ siddhamodanam||(*)(5th line) gaṇeśādi śivāntañca havindadyāt vicakṣaṇaḥ| śītāmbu vātabhedī ca ṣaḍaṅgā(*)modameva ca||(*)(6th line) sundarāmoda sandhānaṃ aṅgaśītalameva ca| śrīpānīyaṃ śriyāmodaṃ santāpaharamevaca|| śrībhadrañcitta santoṣaṃ śitaśekharameva ca|(7th line) varuṇaṃ mārdavañcaiva mantrasantānameva ca|| sittasandīpanañcaiva cittānandāmbuśekharam| pānīyamiti(*)vikhyātaṃ gaṇeśādi śivāntakam||(*)(P.138b, 1st line ) hutavedī hutānandaṃ hutānādevameva ca| kriyāsandhānakaṃ caiva hutavāsaṃ hutāmṛtam|| hutasaṃ(*)bhogakañcaiva kriyāvambodhameva ca|(*)(2nd line) karmasandhānakaṃ caiva kāmadāyikameva ca|| karmapūraṇikā kolaṃ vikacaṃ hutaśekharam| vidhipūrṇāmṛtaṃ (*)siddhaṃ hutadīpakameva ca||(*)(3rd line) gaṇeśādīśaparyantaṃ homadravyaṃ samācaret| ikṣupūrṇaṃ puroḍāmśaṃ vaiṇavaṃ (*)kumudapriyam||(*)(4th line) karpūraṃ lājacūrṇañca saktu pūrikamevaca| sanālikañca kauśeyaṃ go māyūraṃ śivapriyam|| baladaṃ balasandhānāṃ (*)balakārikameva ca|(*)(5th line) yavāmṛtaṃ gaṇeśādi śivāntaṃ balimācaret|| tarkke(kke)śi naṭṭarāgañca megharāgañcakauśikam|(6th line) saindhavantādhavañcaiva pañcamaṃ naṭṭabhāṣaya|| antālikāmarañcaiva gāndhāraṃ pañcamantathā| tarkkeśī naṭṭarāgañca (*)vyālāgreṇī ca kauśikam||(*)(7th line) antālikāmarañcaiva kolī(lli) gāndhārapañcamam| gāndhāraṃ tarka(kka)rāgañca meghanādañca kauśikam|| (P.139a, 1st line) pūrvapañcarakaṃ stotraṃ vighneśādi śivāntakam| śrīraṅgā trividhaṃ proktaṃ navāhaṃ saptapañcakam|| uttamantu navāhañca madhyamaṃ sapta eva ca|(P.143a, 1st line) pañcāhaṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ utsavasya balaṃ bhavet||(P.143b, 1st line) āṣāḍhe cottarāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe śravaṇāntake| pūrvabhādre tathā māse pūrvabhādrāntamucyate|| aśvayujye tathai(*)śvatyai cotsavāntadinaṃ śubham|(*)(2nd line) sarvamāseṣu karttavyāmādrānte tu śivotsavam|| yajāmānaścādine caiva rājā janmadine tathā|(3rd line) dhvajānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye daṇḍasya lakṣaṇaṃ śruṇu|| uttamaṃ madhyamañcaiva adhamañca tridhābhavet| prāsādānte samaṃ (*)daṇḍaṃ prāsādaśirasāntakam||(*)(4th line) mahānāsisamadaṇḍaṃ trividhaṃ cottama kramam| vakṣasthalāntaṃ kuṭāntaṃ gopurāntaṃ tathaiva ca||(5th line) madhyamaṃ tu tribhedañca adhamañca kramāt śruṇu| kuṇḍanāsī sumadhye vā bhū samālairathāpi vā|| pañca(*)hastavimānena samadaṇḍantataḥ kurū|(*)(6th line) trihastena vimānena dviguṇaṃ daṇḍamucyate|| caturhastodvihastārdhaṃ daṇḍārdha(*)ñcaiva yojayet|(*)(7th line) pañcahastantadūrdhve tu madhyamādi ca daṇḍakam|| nirvāṇañca ṛjūñcaiva kṛmikoṭaravarjitam| candanañcaiva (*)dārūñca bilvañcampakameva ca||(*)(P.144a, 1st line) kramukaṃ veṇukañcaiva panasāmrantu vṛkṣakam| kundapannāgakhadiraṃ mārjanaṃ ketakī tathā||(2nd line) ṣaḍvāṅgāṅgulanāhañca uttamantu vidhīyate| caturvimśāṅgulannāhaṃ madhyamantu vidhīyate|| dvādaśāṅgulināhañca adhamaṃ tatrakārayet|(3rd line) caturvimśāṅgulannāhaṃ agrametat ṣaḍahastakam||(8th line) ityevaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā paṭṭayā trividhantathā| pañcatālottamañcaiva madhyamañca caturthakam|| adhamañca tridhā pañcakadalī(*)dalasaṃyutam|(*)(P. 144a.1st line) trikoṇākṛta aṣṭadroṇamayaṃ śālī śālyārdhaṃ (*)taṇḍulaṃ tathā||(*)(3rd line) tasyopari paṭanyastvā likhitvā vṛṣabhādiṣu| paruśuñcaiva khaḍvāṅgaṃ pāśaṃ śūlaṃ tathaiva ca|| chatraṃṃ dīpaṃ (*)dvayañcaiva balipīṭhadvārayoḥ madhye dhvajasthānaṃ viśeṣataḥ| dvihastaṃ vā trihastaṃ vā ekahastamathāpi vā|| karṣayedyastramantreṇa (*)sthāpayet kuṃbhameva ca|(*)(6th line) tatvamūrdhnī daṇḍena sthāpayet vā|(*)(4th line) kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇena baliṃ dadyāt pṛthak pṛthak|| grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vāpi alaṅkṛtvā viśeṣataḥ|(5th line) pītayajñopavītañca nimnonnatasamaprabhe|| sthalaśodhanataṃ kṛtvā tathā (*)prakaraṇopetaṃ maṅgalāgamamāśrataḥ||(*)(5th line) tadante gantamārūḍhaṃ tadante turagavāhanā| yantraṃ raṅgāstadante (*)tu divyastrī parisevitam||(*)(6th line) turayantrāstadante tu tadante gajayantrakam| tadante maṇḍapāyantro tadakṣe dakṣa(*)yantrakā||(*)(7th line) yantradevālayormadhye nṛttageyasamanvitā| sukhāsanantu prathamam akṣavāhaṃ dvitīyakam|| tritīyaṃ tripura(*)ghnantu caturthaṃ candraśekharam|(*)(P.151b,1st line) pañcamañcārdhanārī tu ṣaṣṭhakaṃ harirardhakam|| saptamaṃ bhaikṣamūrttistu cāṣṭamaṃ kāmanāśanam|(2nd line) navamaṃ kāladahanaṃ kalyāṇaṃ daśamaṃ śubham|| ekādaśantu liṅgasthaṃ sādākhyaṃ dvādaśaṃ śubham| trayodaśantu nṛtyaṃ syāt sarvālaṅkāra(*)saṃyutam||(*)(3rd line) raṅgevā śibikāyāṃ vā rathe vā śibike'pi vā| ante pāśupatāścaiva tadantetu mahāvrataḥ| mahāśaivā(*)stadantetu tadante brāhmaṇān kramāt||(*)(4th line) tadante bhairavāssarve tadante siddhisevakāḥ| tadante gānakāssarve tadante (*)nṛttikāstrīyaḥ||(*)(5th line) īśvaraḥ śaktisahitasvatantu gacchet kramāt śanaiḥ| nīlovrataiḥ parivṛtaiḥ sarvalakṣaṇa(*)saṃyutaiḥ||(*)(6th line) nānā puṣpaidhvajaiścitraiḥ nānā cāmarasaṃyutaiḥ| nānā bhūtasamāyuktaiḥ nānā kāhalavārakaiḥ||(7th line) triśūladīpakābhiśca yantradīpairviśeṣataḥ| astadīpaiṣṭa(dīpairaṣṭa)dīpaiśca ssa(sa)rvayantrapaśobhitam||(?) vidhivat arcakaṃbaiśca (*)pātakaiḥ sarvaśobhitaiḥ|(*)(8th line) sarvato pṛṣṭhato gacchan caṇḍanāyakadaivatam|| tadagre ghoṣayet tatra sarvavādyasamāyutam| paṭahai(*)rmaddalaistālaiḥ bherīpaṭahaḍuṇḍubhai||(*)(P.152a,1st line) jhallaryai jharjharaiścaiva vīṇā veṇuśca kinnaraiḥ| agrataḥ pṛṣṭhataścaiva (*)ghoṣayettu viśeṣataḥ||(*)(2nd line) tadante vaiśyaśūdrādīn garjayassarasaṃyutaiḥ| sarvavarṇaistadante tu tadante gajarūpakāḥ|| vṛddhā (*)bālā yuva llībā strīpumān bhoganda gacchagāḥ| (*)(3rd line) tadante bhaktadāsāstu prajeyuḥ kramataḥ punaḥ|| yaddevaṃ anugacchanta tattatkālāntarātmanaḥ|(4th line) padepadeśvame yasya phalaṃ prāpnotimānavaḥ|| sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyante śaivaṃ paramamāpnuyāt| evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt (*)grāmaṃ vā nagarantu vā||(*)(5th line) śanaiḥ devālayaṃ kṛtvā balapīṭhe baliṃ kṣipet| pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā pravidāyanataṃ param||(6th line) maṇḍapādisthitaṃ devaṃ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha| mṛdaṅgādi mahāśabdaiḥ pūjayāma sthitaṃ śivam|| nṛttakairma(*)rdalaiścaiva dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitam|(*)(7th line) gāyakairvamśakaiścaiva uttare caiva samsthitam|| ācāryamaiśa digbhāge nṛpapañcaiva paścime|(8th line) ubhayoparibāhyānte devasya gaṇikā smṛtāḥ|| devasyāgre viśeṣeṇa nṛttaṃ geyaṃ satālakam| nīrāñjanaṃ (*)prakurvīta divastrīṇāntu dhārayet||(*)(P.152b,1st line) bhasmapuṣpañca dīpañca haste sṛk chatracāmaraiḥ| darpaṇaṃ hemakuṃbhañca tripādopari samsthitam|| pādyamācamanandadyāt puṣpaṃ śirasinikṣipet| akṣaraṃ śirasi vinyastvā gandhandadyāt viśeṣataḥ|| ācamanaṃ purādadyāt dhūpadīpaṃ prapūjayet|(3rd line) vaiśyāstu vinyaset dīpān pradakṣiṇarathopari|| tadante dāpayedbhasamaṃ darpaṇaṃ darśayet budhaḥ| gaṇikā gīrvagītvā tu vādyadhvani (*)samāyutam||(*)(4th line) pīṭhāgrevāpi nikṣipya prākārāṇāṃ bahirnikṣipet| yāvadutsavakarmañcet evameva dine dine|| aṣṭamasya tu pūrvetu (*)mṛgayāmāṃ samācaret|(*)(5th line) yuddhāraṃbha prabhāvetu grāmaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam|| kautukaṃ bandhayet dhīmān (*)tasmin rātreviśeṣataḥ|(*)(6th line) sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ sūtraṃ athakārpāsa tantu vā|| sthaṇḍilasyopari sthāpya triśūlañca pradakṣiṇam|(7th line) nadyāṃvāpi taṭākevā hṛtsnānaṃ vāpi kārayet|| yāgamaṇḍape madhye tu śūlasūtreṇa veṣṭayet| hṛdayaṃ mantra(*)muccārya puṇyāhaṃ tatra vācayet||(*)(8th line) utsavasyādi rātrasya sarveṣāṃ kautukannyaset| utsavasyādi rātretu pūjayet (*)parameśvaram|| (*)(P.153a,1st line) pañcavarṇaibalindadyāt pañcavaktreṣu dāpayet| pūrvantu pāyasandadyāddakṣiṇe tu ghṛtantathā|| paścime tu gulānnañca (*)haridrānnañca uttare|(*)(2nd line) śuddhānnaṃ ūrdhvavaktre tu naivedyaṃ pañcasaṃyutam|| trasandhyarcanaṃ kuryāt rājārāṣṭrābhi vṛddhidam| pūjānte karmahomantu (*)haste balipradakṣiṇam||(*)(3rd line) pādyamācamanarghyaiśca gandhaiḥ pūṣpaiśca dhūpakaiḥ| dīpaiścaiva nivedyaiśca trikāla(*)ñcārcanaṃ bhavet||(*)(4th line) śūlasya pīṭhikādyaiva tāmbūlaṃ rudrarūpakam| sakalanniṣkalañcaiva indrādyā devatā ṛṣī||(5th line) rājadvāre śriyādevī sabhāsthāne naṭeśvaram| ādityañca mahendrañcagrāmapūrvādi daivatāḥ|| gandharvadevāḥ siddhāśca (*)dakṣiṇadvāradevatāḥ|(*)(6th line) sugandhī śoṣṇī(*)caiva paścimadvāradaivatāḥ||(*)(7th line) mukhyāścaiva tu khaḍvāṅgī uttaradvāradevatāḥ| udyāne tu mahādevi goṣṭhe caiva tu gomukhī||(8th line) durgāsthāṇe viśeṣe tu aṇḍābharaṇadaivatāḥ| rudrarūpī śivasthāne viṣasthāne tu vaiṣṇavī|| brahmasthāne sarasvatyā gurū(*)sthāne manonmanī|(*)(P.153b,1st line) taṭāke candradaivantu kūpecaiva śivastathā|| vallīke nāradaścaiva parvate parameśvaram| citrasthāne tu gandharvāṃ nadīsthāne (*)tu kāruṇā||(*)(2nd line) gajasthāne tu vighneśaṃ aśvasthāne tu cārkanīm| homasthāne pārvatīñca bhasmasnāne pīśācakāḥ|| ityete sarvadevāśca (*)svanāmādyairbaliṃ dadet|(*)(3rd line) mudgapuṣpodanā pūrvaiḥ saktu lājaistilairapi|| sarveṣāṃ sarvataddravyaṃ svanāmestu nivedayet|(4th line) āmrakelīphalañcaiva kadalīphalameva ca|| laḍḍāpūpa gulānnañca tāmbūlantu nivedayet|(5th line) daridrāyadukhanañcaiva sarvakāmya samṛ्ddhidam|| balimātrapramāṇena śivalokemahīyate| cūrṇotsavakramaṃ vakṣye (*)śruṇuṣveva maheśvaraḥ||(*)(6th line) prāsādāt paścimebhāge śālibhiścaturaśrakam| lūkhalaṃ (ulūkhalam)musalañcaiva kṣālayet astramantrakān|| sthaṇḍilasya tu madhye tu lūkhalaṃ praṇavannayaset|(7th line) navapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya sarvapuṣpairalaṅkatam|| aṅkurānapitān kuryāt arcayitvā (*)yathākramam|(*)(P.154a,1st line) haridramuśiraṃ koṣṭhakaṃ karpūrantu suvacchilā|| lūkhalasya tu kramaṃ madhye haridraṃ madhyamenyaset| sadyamantrakaṃ samu(*)ccārya arcayitvā maheśvaram||(*)(2nd line) ācāryanantarañcaiva cūrṇakarmantu dāpayet| tadante brāhmaṇān bhukte tadante bhaktimān janān||(3rd line) rudrāsi gaṇikācaiva navavastraiśca śobhitāḥ| aṅkuśo tamaṃ kuryāt gandhapuṣpaiśca śobhitam|| nṛttageyaiśca vādyai(*)śca cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā muhurmuhuḥ|(*)(4th line) liṅge darpaṇaśūletu pratime paricārakaiḥ|| tailañcālepayitvā tu dakṣiṇe(*)śvaramabhyagān|(*)(5th line) ācāryasya nṛpasyaiva bhaktānāñcaiva dūrjayet|| sarvajātaistuto kuryāt pūrṇa(*)tālantu dāpayet|(*)(6th line) śaṅkhakāhalakādyaiśca bheryādi dhvanisaṃyutam|| brāhmaṇān ghoṣayitvā tu svastimaṅgalavācakaiḥ|(7th line) grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vāpi śīghṃ gacchet pradakṣiṇam|| nadīsindhutaṭāke vā tandevatva pradāpayet| sthaṇḍilantatra karttavyaṃ (*)dīpamaṣṭadalaṃ bhavet||(*)(P.154b,1st line) triśūlaṃ tatra samsthāpya tadagre tu kalānyaset| śūlasyacottare sthāpya yāgadevaṃ maheśvaraḥ||(2nd line) gandhapuṣpādinā pūjya tāmbūlantu nivedayet| pratimābhimukhaṃ kuryāt sthaṇḍile vālukāmaye|| navapātrāṇi saṅgrāhya (*)sudṛḍhaṃ sasvaraṃ śubham|(*)(3rd line) sthaṇḍilasyottare deśe pātrāṇāṃ śuddhikāṃ punaḥ|| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu (*)stotrairmaṅgalavācakaiḥ|(*)(4th line) ācāryamukhato madhye gandhatoyairanukramāt|| anantādi śikhaṇḍāntaṃ (*)kalaśeṣvabhito'nnyaset|(*)(5th line) arcyantu nikṣipet tatra aṅgapratyaṅgavinyaset|| suvastraṃ voṣṭayitvā tu tulasīñca pradāpayet|(6th line) gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca arcayitvā kramam||(yathākramam) arcayet pratimaṃ śūlaḥ sṛṣṭisthityanta hetukam|(7th line) pādyamācamanarghyaiśca gandhapuṣpaiśca pūjayet|| balivācakakāle tu sarvadevantu cārcayet| snanapanaṃ (*)tatprakurvīta pādyaṃ sadyetu dāpayet||(*)(P.150a,1st line) puruṣeṇācamaṇañcaiva īśānenārghyamucyate| pañcagavyañca cārghyañca (*)pañcabrahmasyadāpayet|| (*)(2nd line) ghṛtamiśraṃ ghṛtasnānandadhiviho dadhisthitā| kṣīrapāyāsamantreṇa madhuvā vā madhustathā|| nadīnā(*)matamadhye tu prathamaṃ snānamācaret|(*)(3rd line) śūlasnānantataḥ kṛtvā kautukaṃ tīrthakadvayam|| tīrthaṃ mahāvaśyaṃ pālanaṃ (*)śatrunāśanam||(*)(4th line) sarvarogaharaṃ bhūtaṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ sarvasiddhidam| devālayaṃ samāśritya puṇyāhaṃ tatrakārayet||(5th line) liṅgantu pratimāṃ śūlaṃ sakalārādhanakramāt| pūrvavadyāgasaṃyuktaṃ pu(…)ryāgannavāhakam||(6th line) maunayāgaṃ tataḥ kuryāt devayāgamanantaram| mṛgayāgaṃ tataḥ kuryāt gandhayāgamanantaram|| pūrvoktaṃ yāgamevantu caretsarvaphalaṃ (*)labhet|(*)(7th line) caṇḍeśvarasya yāgantu yathoktaṃ kārayet śubham|| yāgaśāle sthitaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mūlabimbestu pūjayet|(P.155b,1st line) caṇḍapracaṇḍavikrānta caṇḍeśañcaiva devataḥ|| sarvaśatruharaṃ śuddhaṃ pūjayeścaṇḍadaivatam| dhvajāvasānaṃ kṛtvā (*)dhvajasnānaṃ vivarjayet||(*)(2nd line) brahmādyaiśānaparyantaṃ balīnāntu pradāpayet| supīṭhodvāsanaṃ kuryāt astramantreṇa śabdakam||(3rd line ) balipīṭhe balinyastvā pūjayet tu viśeṣataḥ| pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā ācāryaṃ pūjayet kramāt||(4th line) hārakeyūrakaṭakaṃ hemayajñopavītakam| gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca ācāryantu prapūjayet||(5th line) ācāryo utsavāne tu bhaktotsavavidhiṃ śruṇu| bhaktānāṃ pratimāyāñca kautukaṃ bandhayet kramāt||(6th line) pūrvoktavat alaṅkāranṛttagānañca saṃyutam| agrataprativṛktaiśca vedadhvanisamāyutam|| grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā (*)devālaye praveśayet|(*)(7th line) devālaye pratiṣṭhādi sthāpayet bhaktarūpakam|| arcanaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā bhakte(*)bhyo vastradāpayet|(*)(P.156a,1st line) pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā siddhāṃ devān samarcayet|| evaṃ paramaśaktistu utsavaṃ vidhipūrvakam|(2nd line) kulaikavaṃśam udhṛtya śivaloke mahīyate|| rājarāṣṭrābhivṛdhyarthaṃ utsavantu maheśvaram| tasmāt sarvaprayatnena (*)cotsavaṃ kārayet kramāt||(*)(3rd line) utsavaṃ kārayet dhīmān śivotsavaṃ prakalpayet| śivotsavāntamidaṃ proktaṃ (*)prāyaścittakramaṃ śruṇu||(*)(4th line) ||[iti makuṭāgame utsavavidhi paṭalaḥ]|| tulāmāse ayyāsvāmi svahastalikhitam||(P.156b,1st line) prāyavināśa ityarthaṃ cittaṃ santāpamucyate| vināśayanti santāpān prāyaścittamiti smṛtam|| karṣaṇādyarccanāṃ taṃ tu (*)prāyaścittaṃ vadāmyaham|(*)(2nd line) arcanāhīnakāle tu sandhyādviguṇātathā|| evaṃ sandhyārcanāhīne hṛṇmantreṇa śatāhuti|(3rd line) pāyasānnaṃ nivedyantu punaḥ pūrvaivat ca arcayet|| ekāhabhyarcanāhīne snapanaṃ navakuṃbhakam| gulānnena tu naivedyaṃ (*)pūrvavat pūjayet śubham||(*)(4th line) viśeṣañcārcanaṃ kṛtvā śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet| caturthāhe tu pañcāhe (*)pūjāhīne tu saṃbhavet||(*)(5th line) pañcāśat saṅkhyayā caiva kalaśasnānamācaret| ṣaḍ dināni daśāhanta karakā(*)śītakuṃbhakaiḥ||(*)(6th line) ekādaśādi pañcāśat pūjāhīne tu saṃbhavet| kārayitvā śivāgnintu ekapañcāśatāṣṭakaiḥ||(7th line) pūrvavat pūjanaṃ kṛtvā naivedyaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet| śivāmantraṃ śataṃ hutvā pāyasānnaṃ nivedayet|| pūjāhīne tu sāta(*)ntrīśataiśca kalaśaiḥ śubhaiḥ|(*)(8th line) hṛnmantrañca śataṃ hutvā kṣīrānnantu nivedayet|| dvimāsamarcanāhīne sahasrakalaśaiḥ kramāt|(P.157a,1st line) ṣānmāsaṃ arcanāhīne samprokṣaṇamathācaret|| sandhyāyaṃ balihīne tu anyasandhye balidvayam| dvisandhi balihīne tu (*)snapanaṃ kārayet tataḥ||(*)(2nd line) dvirahāirī ca māsāntaṃ balivicchedakarmaṇi| ṣivāgniṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā snapanañcaśatāṣṭakam|| balimāsordhvahīne tu (*)śivāgniṃ pūjayet kramāt|(*)(3rd line) sahasrājyāhutiṃ hutvā śivamantreṇa deśikaḥ|| aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuṃbhai snapanaṃ kārayet (*)śubham|(*)(4th line) bhāradvayantu naivedyamekāhecotsavaṃ śubham|| strīśūdrasparśane caiva caṇḍāla(*)sparśane tathā|(*)(5th line) pañcaviṃśati snapanaṃ śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet|| puṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra bhaktānāñcaiva pūjayet| balibhramaṇa(*)kāle tu liṅgaṃ patitemeva vā||(*)(6th line) sphaṭitañcalitaṃ bhinnaṃ nāśañcaiva tu saṃbhavet| tatraivaṃ kārayet homamathavā (*)ālayamadhyate(me)||(*)(7th line) pūrvavat baliliṅgentu kṛtvā tatra pradakṣiṇam| athavā pūrvavat kṛtvā śivamantraṃ śataṃ hunet|| mūlamantraṃ japet tatra (*)aṣṭottaraśataṃ bhavet|(*)(P.157b,1st line) āgamyamitigamyaṃ vā śivamantraṃ śataṃ japet|| tatkāle dīpahīnetu sthitvā baliṃ tataḥ kramāt| puna(*)rdīpaṃ samāvāhya kṛtvā śeṣaṃ pradakṣiṇam||(*)(2nd line) naivedyadravayahīnetu dviguṇantu nivedayet| gavyahīne tu dviguṇaṃ maheśaṃ niutyahīnatu||(3rd line) nityāgnikāryahīne tu hṛnmantreṇaśatāhutīm| utsave tu viśeṣe prāyaścittavidhi(dhiṃ) śruṇuṃ|| vṛṣayāga(*)vihīneutu dhvajārohaṇahīnake|(*)(4th line) dhvajavedivihīnetu kuṇḍavedi vihīnake|| dhvajaghaṇṭāvihīnetu patitā(*)ñcaiva hīnake|(*)(5th line) aṣṭamaṅgalahīnetu divyāyudhavihīnake|| aṅkurārpaṇahīnatu astrayāgavihīnake|(6th line) mantrahīne kriyāhīne darbhāparidhi hīnake|| kalaśasthāpana hīnetu kuṃbhahīnetu nirjale| ratnahemavihīne tu kūrcasūtravihīnake||(7th line) kūrcaṃ paridhihīnetu vastrahīne tathaiva ca| naivedyādi vihīne tu dhūpadīpavihīnake|| balidravya vihīne tu balidānavihīnake|(P.158a,1st line) baliliṅgavihīne tu śūlādīn patite'thavā|| balipātravihīne tu rathāti kramaṇena tu| utsave yāgahīnetu tatkāle (*)kalahe'pi ca||(*)(2nd line) pūjāparyūṣitadravye tu śaṅkarau liṅgabimbayoḥ| pratimāṃ yānakāletu patitetāṅgahīnake| utsava(*)ñcaiva tatgrāme mṛtecaiva manuṣyake||(*)(3rd line) pariṣecanaṃ ca rajanīmagnīdaṇḍau bhayaṅkarau| rakṣāsūtravihīne tu kautukasnānahīnakau||(4th line) ārabhya anyatantreṇa śivayāgakṛte śarī| mantrāṇāṃ śarkarañcaiva hīnedvāḍārya dakṣiṇe||(5th line) evamādi samutpanne grāmādīnāntu doṣakṛt| vṛṣayāgavihīne tu gāvonaśyantu na samśayaḥ|| vṛṣabhasnapanaṃ kṛtvā (*)gandhapuṣpena yojayet|(*)(6th line) nivedayettu mudgānnaṃ śāntihomantu kārayet|| dhvajārohaṇahīnetu rājādurjayamāpnuyāt|(7th line) śāntihomantataḥ kuryāt vidhinīropayet budhaḥ|| dhvajavedivihīne tu mantrīṇāntu bhayaṅkaram|(P.158b,1st line) śāntihomantataḥ kṛtvā punassandhānamāpnuyāt|| rajjuhīne dhvajacchinne naṣṭe ca patite tathā| dhvajayaṣṭivihīne tu rājāpatnīñca (*)nāśanam||(*)(2nd line) pūrvavat kalpayet caiva puṇyāhaṃ tatra vācayet| śāntihomantataḥ kṛtvā bhaktānāṃ caiva pūjayet|| ghaṇḍāhīne tu patite (*)phalānāñca kṣayaṃ bhavet|(*)(3rd line) puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu mūlamantraṃ śataṃ japet|| ghaṇḍāmastreṇa samprokṣya punassandhānamarcayet|(4th line) bherītāḍana hīne tu paracakrāt bhayaṃ bhavet|| snapanaṃ kārayettatra śaṃbhopūrveva tāṭa(ḍa)yet|(5th line) ghoṣakāle patite paṭahecchinna hīnake|| carmachedanakāle tu sadyonāśa vinirdiśet| svarṇamantramanusmṛtya catvārjaptvā śataṃ japet||(6th line) antyenaiva parigrāhya vidhinā tāṭa(ḍa)yet śivam| yāgaśālāvihīne tu sasyanāśana samśayaḥ|| pañcagavyena (*)samprokṣya mūlamantraṃ śataṃ japet|(*)(7th line) vidhinā sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva sna(snā)payet kramāt|| yāgaśālāgni daṇḍetu sthāpitaṃ (*)tarpaṭe'thavā|(*)(P.159a,1st line) paracakrādbhayaṃ bhūmau rājādurjayamāpnuyāt|| pūrvavat yāgaśāle tu ghaṭavannūnamārabhet| punarutsavamārabhya (*)taddinādiṣu pūrvavat||(*)(2nd line) pramādādini daṇḍe ca pūrvavat kalpayetkramāt| puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu hṛnmantreṇa śataṃ hunet||(3rd line) sṛksṛvañca vihīne tu atīvajalamāritam| mahāvyādhi pravarttante nityaṃ grāmanivāsinam|| tryambaketimantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ (*)hunet|(*)(4th line) darbhamālāvihīne ca anāvṛṣṭiṃ pravartate|| mūlamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā darbhamālā tu yojayet| homadravya (*)vihīne tu anāvṛṣṭiḥ na samśayaḥ||(*)(5th line) astraṇaiva śataṃ hutvā mahāvyāhṛti homayet| taddravyaṃ homayet dhīmān (*)pūrvoktavidhinā saha||(*)(6th line) āyudhānāṃ vihīne ca taskareṇabhayaṅkaram| tryakṣareṇa tu mantreṇa homārcitasi saṅkhyayā|| kṛtvā salakṣaṇenaiva (*)samprokṣaṇaśivāṃbhasā|(*)(7th line) aṣṭamaṅgalahīne tu janānāñcaiva nāśanam|| īśamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā kārayet lakṣaṇānvitam|(P.159b,1st line) pañcadravyeṇa samprokṣya pūrvavat sthāpayet kṛtam|| aṅkurārpaṇa hīne ca pālikādīnī hṛīnake| mahāvyādhi samutpannaṃ sasyanāśaṃ na samśayaḥ||(2nd line) sahasramūlamantreṇa hutvā bhaktāprapūjayet| śobhāṅkurārpaṇaṃ kuryāt lakṣaṇaṃ pālikādibhiḥ|| astrayāgavihīne ca (*)mahāmārīpravṛttayet|(*)(3rd line) mūrttihomantataḥ kṛtvā snapanaṃ navakuṃbhakaiḥ|| yāgādhivāsanaṃ tatrakuryāt pūrvoktamārgataḥ| mūlamantraṃ (*)śatañjaptvā darbhamālā tu yojayet||(*)(4th line) homadravyahīne tu anāvṛṣṭiṃ na samśayaḥ| kuṃbhasthāpana hīne ca vardhanīṃ ratnahīnake||(5th line) vihīne sūtrakecaiva ca aṣṭamaṅgalahīnake| kurcaṃ vitāna hine ca astrahīne unmattaṃ jāyate dhṛvam|| aghoramantrārcitaṃ hutvā punassandhānamācaret|(P.160a,1st line) balidravyahīne ca dīpamāropayet tataḥ| durbhikṣaṃ jāyate ṇḍva(?) havinivicchedanādibhiḥ|| bhasmāgārantadādhyasya nidhāyāgniñca pūjayet|(2nd line) samidhājñeyataḥ kṛtvā juhūyāṃ mūlamantrataḥ|| pratyekṛtaśataṃ hutvā dravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hunet| vaṇijyācalite (*)hīne jvaravyādhistajāyate||(*)(3rd line) juhūyādastramantreṇa śatañcaivārdhahomayet| mantrahīne manodukhaṃ gulmādiñca (*)jāyate||(*)(4th line) mūlamantraṃ śataṃ hutvā hamsamantraṃ śatañjapet| uktadravyaiśca mantraiśca vidhinā homamācaret|| darbhā (*)paridhihīne ca patite ca viśeṣataḥ|(5th line) dravyanāśakarañcaiva gavānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet|| vājayet tatra dravyantu nava(*)dravyaṃ astramantreṇa juhuyāt japañca śivamantrakam| śeṣasthāne balindadyāt praviśedyāgamaṇḍapam|| śūlasyadaṇḍavicchinne varjayettu samudrakam|(3rd line) astrañca taṃ parigrāhya yāgaśeṣaṃ samācaret|| śuddhāstrantu punaḥkṛtvā sthāpayet vidhipūrvakam| anyāgni tat vibhedena (*)punassandhānamācaret||(*)(4th line) jalādhivāsanecaiva pratiṣṭhākālabhedanam| āyudhāni pranaṣṭau tu bhinnaiva
