svāhāntenā hutitrayaṃ hutvā vidyā tatvaṃ seṣvaramabhyarcya| prakyekaṃ āhutitrayaṃ datvā mūrttimūrttīśvarānabhyarcya|(2nd line) pratyekamāhutibhiḥ santarpyamadhyabhāga śudhyarthaṃ vṛṣamūlena (3rd line) pañcaviṃśatyāhutiṃ brahmāṅgānāṃ daśāṃśato hutvā pūrṇāṃ datvā śāntijalenā madhyabhāgaṃ saṃprokṣya kuśamadhyena vṛṣamadhyaṃ saṃspṛśya homasaṅkhyā(4th line)
japaṃ vidhāyāgni sadanaṃ gatvā vidyātatvaṃ śivatatve naikībhūtaṃ dhyātvā oṃ hīṃ hūṃ vidyāśivatatvābhyāṃ namaḥ|(5th line) ityabhyarcya āhuti trayaṃ datvā| śivatatvaṃ seśvaramabhyarcya| pratyekamāhutibhiḥ santarpya mūrtti mūrttīśvarārcanaṃ homañca pūrvadvidhāya|(6th line) ūrdhvabhāga śudhyarthaṃ pūrvavat dhṛtvā| vṛṣāntikaṃ gatvā| śāntyaṃbhasā prokṣya| (P.182b,1st line) kuśāgreṇa tadagraṃ saṃspṛśya| pūrvavat japtvāgni sadanaṃ gatvā pūrvandadyāt | tataḥ paṭasthāstra samīpaṃ gatvā| tamastreṇa saṃprokṣya| ṣaḍutthāsanandatvā(2nd line) | tadavayavādhiṣṭhitān rudrādīnabhyarcya| śivāstraṃmūlāṅgairāviṣkṛtya| gandhādibhirabhyarcya| vahnāvapyevaṃ astraṃ saṃpūjyāstra(3rd line) mantreṇa mantratarpaṇārthaṃ pañcaviṃśatyāhutiṃ brahmāṅgānāṃ pratyekamāhutibhiḥ strībhiśca hutvā| pūrṇāndatvā mastramantreṇa(4th line) samidājya carūbhirvā kevalaṃ sarpiṣā vā śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā hutvā| pūrṇāndatvā| vahnāvapyādhāra śaktimabhyarcyāhuti trayaṃ datvā| (5th line) astrātma tatvāstra vidyātatvāstra śivatatvāni brahmaviṣṇu rudrādhiṣṭhitāni saṃpujya| pratyekantribhistribhirāhutibhiḥ santarpya|(6th line)
tribhāgaśudhyarthaṃ pratyekaṃ daśāhutiṃ hutvā| paṭasthāstṛṃ gatvā śāntyaṃṃbhasā saṃprokṣya| astramūlamadhyāgreṣu kuśamūlamadhyāgraiḥ(7th line) saṃspṛśya| homasaṅkhyā japaṃ vidhāya| kuṇḍāntikaṃ gatvā| astramantreṇa pūrṇāndatvā| prāyaścitārthaṃ vṛṣamūlenāṣṭottaraśataṃhutvā| (P.183a,1st line) pūrṇāndatvāstramantreṇa niṣkṛtyarthaṃ pañcaviṃśatyāhutiṃ pūrṇāsahitaṃ hutvā|vahnistha vṛṣāstrayoḥ (2nd line) naivedyādikandatvā abhyarcya parāṅmukhārghyaṃ datvā| bhasmavandayitvā| vahnisthavṛṣāstrau paṭavṛṣāstṛyoḥ saṃyojyāgniṃ visṛjya| paridhi viṣṭarasthebhye (3rd line) balindatvā arghyayitvātān visṛjya| paridhiviṣṭarān parasṛtyāntarbali bahirbaliñca datvā| pādau prakṣālyācamya bhasmaṃ dhṛtvā| (4th line) sakalīkṛtya| paṭasthāyaghaṭasthāya gandhapuṣpādikaṃ dāpayet| tata utsavāṅkurārthaṃ yāgaśālāyāmudīcyāṃ vāyavyāṃ(5th line) vātadaṅkurārpaṇa nimittaṃ saṃkalpya| puṇyāhaṃ vīcayitvā| pūrvoktavidhānena utsavāṅkurārpaṇaṃ vidadhyāt| atha (6th line) bherītāḍanārthamastrarājāntikaṃ gatvā| vighneśvaramabhyarcya| saṅkalpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā astrarājaṃ bherīñca saṃprokṣya| (7th line) astramūle ṣaḍutthāsanamabhyarcya| astrāsanāya huṃphaṇaṇmaḥ| astramūrttaye huṃphaṇṇamaḥ| ityāsanamūrttiṃ vicintyasya| madhyapatrādya vayaveṣu|(P.183,b1st line) rudrādīn abhyarcya| śivāstramantraṃ mantreṇavāhyāṅgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya| gandhādibhirabhyarcya naivedyādikaṃ datvā| bherīsamīpaṃ gatvā| bharīsthaṇḍile (2nd line) ṣaḍutthāsanaṃ abhyarcya| praṇavātmikāṃ bherīmūrttindhyātvābhyarcya| madhye rudradakṣiṇebrahmāṇaṃ vāme viṣṇudakṣiṇa valaye sūryaṃ vāmavalaye(3rd line) somaṃ saptakīlemātṛn| navakīle grahāt ekādaśa kīlarudrān carmasūtre vāsukīn prahare pañcābhyarcya(4th line)
paranādarūpaṃ bharikā mūlamāvāhyāṅgairabhyarcya| dhenumudrayāmṛtīkṛtya| parāṅmukhārghyaṃ datvā| naivedyādikaṃ samarcya| astramantraṃ uccaran | dakṣiṇahastena praharaṃ grahītvā| bherīkāyāṃ pūrvapalake prathamameka prahāraṃ dvitīyaṃ dviprahāraṃ tṛtīyantriprahāraṃ vā trayamapyeka prahāraṃ vā santāḍyā| tat prahāra pūrvamastake vinyasya| yathākarmeṇa devatāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā| tadanantaraṃ pādakamahūya pañcākṣaramanusmarantaṃ (P.184,a1st line)
saṃprokṣya tasyottarīya yopavītaṃ datvā| taddhaste salilaṃ kusumandatvā| so'pi puṣupāñjali vidhinā bherikāryāṃ puṣpaṃ samarpya| bherīṃ skandendhasamāropya|(2nd line) vividhāni tālānivādayet| atha dhvajārohaṇanimittaṃ yathoktaṃ vidhāyā| daṇḍopadaṇḍaskandha valayāni niṣpādya saṃsathāpya taduktamārgeṇa (3rd line) vedikāṃ kṛtvā| daṇḍamūlayanopalipya piṣṭacūrṇaiḥ vicitrīkṛtya| dhvajapaṭavṛkṣakṛṃbhāśca daṇḍamūle niveśya| (4th line) daṇḍarajau dhvaja(…)sakūrca ghaṇḍamālādikaṃ badhvā dhvajābhimukhaṃ nītvā| saṅkalpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| daṇḍaṃ saṃprokṣya (5th line)
(…)lestra rājamabhyarcya daṇḍamūle ṣaḍutthāsanamabhyarcya| daṇḍantridhā vibhajyāgrāt krameṇa (6th line) śivatatvādikaṃ seśvaramabhyarcya| skandhatyamupadaṇḍantathaiva abhyarcya| valaye sūryaṃ rajjauśaktiṃ daṇḍe śivañca saṃpūjya| paṭavṛṣe (7th line) vṛṣāsanādi vikalpenā viṣkṛtya vṛṣakuṃbhāt bījamādāya patasthe saṃyojya| tat parivārān vṛṣetat sthāne saṃyojya| tadaṅgaiḥ sakalīkṛtya (P.184b,1st line) dhūpadīpau datvā| tat samaye dvijebhyo yathā śaktidatvotsaveśvaraṃ natvā vṛṣamūlena paṭaṃ śīghramāropya| tat rajjunā daṇḍaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ(2nd line) āveṣṭya daṇḍamūle badhvā vṛṣakuṃbhajalaṃ daṇḍamūlebhiṣicya kalaśāntattat sthābhiṣicya| daṇḍamūlaṃ vastramālādibhiralaṅkratya| vṛṣendrāya(3rd line) mudgānnaṃ nivedya| vṛṣavidyeśvaramubhyo balindatvā dhūpadīpau dāpayet| tataḥ diglokapālāvāhanāyāṃ astrarājāṃ na liṅgacaṇḍeśvara(4th line) daśāyudhaiḥ saha pañcagavyaṃ balyantañca saṅgrahya| brahmasthānādi tovendra sthānādi to vā| pratyake dvāre tu varūṇādi (5th line) niṛtyantaṃ vā tattat lokapālān tattatguṇakathanenāhūya| tattat tālarāgādisahitaṃ tattat sthāne tattat lokapālān abhyarcya (6th line) svāhāntai svasvamantraiḥ baliṃ kṣiptvā| ālayaṃ praviśya| mahāpīṭhenityavat baliṃ kṣipet|(7th line) tataḥ tīrthāṅkurārthaṃ yāgaśālāṃ pūrvokta deśe pūrvavat aṅkurārpaṇaṃ vidadhyāt| tadanantaraṃ rakṣābandhanārthaṃ (8th line)
tadanukulaiḥ dravyaiḥ sahotsaveśvara sannidhiṃ gatvā| saṅkalpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā| sthaṇḍile ādhāraśaktiṃ yantrikāyāṃ ātma (P.185a,1st line) vidyā śivātmakaṃ tatvatrayaṃ pātre prakṛtiṃ taṇḍule samhitāmantrān bhasmālaye māyātatvaṃ bhasite lakulīśvaraṃ sūtre nandañca saṃpūjya|(2nd line) devadevīmaṣṭapuṣpikayā saṃpūjya| tryaṃbakemantreṇa devyāvāmahaste devyāgāyatryāca sūtraṃ bandhayitvā| bṛhatsāmeti(3rd line) bhasitā samarpyāpūpādyupahāraṃ nivedyaṃ dhūpadīpau datvā| bhagavān utsavārthaṃ anayā devyā yāgadhānaviśeṣeṇa (4th line) lonugrahaṃ karotviti vijñāpya| astrarājamadhyapatre ca daśāyudhānāñca anyeṣāṃ yānayogyānāṃ pratimānāñca kautukaṃ (5th line) bandhayet| tatoyāgamaṇḍapeśa krānalayoḥ madhye kuṃbhe sūryaṃ saṃpūjya| sāmānyārghyeṇa dvāramastreṇā(6th line) saṃprokṣya| pūrvādadikṣu catustoraṇeṣu śāntibhūti balārogyatoraṇān saṃpūjya| pūrvādi dvārakuṃbheṣu śāntividyānivṛtti (7th line) pratiṣṭhādvārāṇi saṃpūjya| pūrvādidvāreṣu dvaudvau dvārān| tattaddakṣiṇa vāmayoḥ| nandikālau bhṛṅgi vināyakau vṛṣaskandau(P.185b,1st line) devīcaṇḍau saṃpūjya| pūrvādi phalakāsuvajrādīn saṃpūjya| pūrvādidhvajeṣu kumudāya kumudākṣāya puṇḍarīkāya vāmanāya(2nd line) śaṅkukarṇāya sarvanetrāya sumukhāya supratiṣṭhāya namaḥ| itī saṃpūjya| paścimenityavat dvārapūjāṃ vidhāyāntaḥpraviśya(3rd line) vedikādakṣiṇe sthitvā| yāgamaṇḍapa kaṃpiṣu(-) pṛthivī tatvam| tṛṇeṣu(-) jalatatvam| bandheṣu(-) vahnitatvam| vaṃśeṣu(-)vāyutatvam|sthūṇāsu(-) ākāśatatvam| (4th line) vitāne(-) candram| darbhamālāyāṃ(-) vāsukīñca saṃpūjya| aṣṭamaṅgaleṣu(-)darpaṇe(-) sūryaṃ kuṃbhe varūṇam vṛṣe(5th line) vṛṣañcāmare māratiśvaṃ śrīvatse lakṣmī svastikebhāratīṃ śaṅkhevimalaṃ dīpahavyavāhañca saṃpūjya|vedikā (6th line) dakṣiṇataḥ sadāśivavyāptikaṃ maṇḍapaṃ saṃbhāvya| tatropaviśya| nityavat bhūtaśudhyādikaṃ vidhāya| viśeṣārgyaṃ saṅakalpya (7th line) ātmārcanaṃ mantraśuddhiñca vidhāya| śivahastaṃ saṅkalpya| svamastake vinyasya| ṣaṭtriṃśat darbhajātaṃ jñānakhaḍgaṃ saṅgṛhya| śivohaṃ(8th line) saṃbhāvya| pañcagavyaṃ saṃsthāpya| maṇḍapaṃ pañcagavyenāstreṇa saṃprokṣya| naiṛtadeśamāgatya| tatra nirīkṣaṇādi catuṣpathāntaiḥ (P.186a,1st line) aṣṭādaśa saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtya| tadupari lājān vinyasya| kuśakurvīkāryā vikīrya| yāgeśvara varddhanī mūlenikṣipya| naiṛta kuṃbhe(2nd line) vāstunāthaṃ paścimeghaṭe lakṣmīñca saṃpūjya| īśānādiśakuṃbhe ṣaḍutthāsanena vṛṣaṃ śivāsanamabhyarcya| mūrttibrahmavidyādeha netra(3rd line) mūlāṅgairāviṣkṛtya| vardhanyāṃ vyālāsanamabhyarcya| pāśupatāstraṃ mūrttimūlaṃ sāṅgamabhyarcya| maṇḍapābhyantara kalaśeṣu lokapālān saṃpūjya| (4th line) tebhyo yajñarakṣādhurāmāpedya varddhanīdhārānugataṃ kuṃbhaṃ mūlenāstra durgamanusmaraman paribhrāmya| tau svasthāne niveśya| kuṃbhe (5th line) sthirāsane śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ sāvaraṇamabhyarcya| varddhanyāṃ pāśupatāstraṃ āsanamūrtti mūlāṅgaiḥ saṃpūjya| naivedyādikaṃ datvā| (6th line) liṅgamudrayābhagaliṅga samāyogaṃ kṛtvā|ślokam(—) umāyai bhagarupiṇyai liṅgarūpadharāya ca| śaṅkarāyanamastubhyaṃ (*)iti stutvānumodya ca||(*)(7th line)
yajñasyāsya patistvaṃ hi mūrttireṣā tavācalā| ete ca jñānaṣaṭtriṃśatgrahāṇa svamāyudham|| iti citkhaḍgaṃ datvā| (8th line) mūlena yathāśakti japtvā| nivedya daśaṃśamastramantraṃ japtvā| vardhanyāṃ samabhyarcya|śalokam(—) mayā pravartitaścāyaṃ yajvanābhavataḥ kratuḥ|(P.186b,1st line)
rakṣaṇīyastyaivaṃ hi samāptiryā vadasya hi|| iti vijñāpya| nirodhārghyaṃ datvā| vāyukuṃbhe gaṇapatimaiśānyāṃ gurūn saṃpūjayet|(2nd line) tato yāgeśvarārādhanāya vedikāmadhya kuṃbhe śaktyādi śaktiparyantaṃ āsanamabhyarcya| tadupari śivamūrttiṃ saṃpūjya| daṇḍabhaṅgyā(3rd line) brahmāṇi vinyasya| aṣṭatraṃśat kalābhedena muṇḍavaktra kalābhaṅgibhiḥ lipinyāsena śāktaṃ vidyādehaṃ niṣpādya netrāṇi datvā| āvaraṇapūjāṃ vidhāya|(4th line)
vardhanyāṃ manonmanīṃ āsanādi vikalpyena sāṅgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ saṃpūjya| paritoṣṭa kuṃbheṣu pūrvādi(5th line) vidyeśvarān abhyarcya| naivedyadhūpadīpādi japāntaṃ saṃpūjayet| utsaveśvarālayaṃ praviśya| sakalikṛtyārghyaṃ (6th line) saṃsādya maheśa vidhinā dvārapūjāṃ kṛtvāntaḥ praviśya| maheśvagāyatryā puṣpaṃ samarpya| nirmālyādikaṃ paranīrya(7th line) thocitena beraśuddhiṃ kṛtvā| sakalārcanamārgena āsanaṃ saṅkalpya| tadupari mūrttimantreṇābhyarcya ekatriṃśat kalānyāsena(8th line) lipivinyāsenā viṣkṛtyā| vidyādehanetramūlāṅgaiḥ saṃpūjyāvaraṇamabhyarcya| devīskandaṃ yathoktenābhyarcya| naivedyadhūpadīpādibhiḥ saṃpūjya| (P.187a,1st line) homakarmakaromiti vijñāpayet|(side heading) tato guruḥ labdhānujñorghyapātramādāya| yāgagṛhaṃ (2nd line) divyadṛṣṭyāvilokayan pradakṣiṇaṃ gatvā| kuṇḍasamīpopaviśya| kuṇḍasaṃskāraṃ kuryāt | tatrāṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ nyastamūlena cakṣuṣā(3rd line) kuṇḍasya nirīkṣaṇam| astaramantreṇa prokṣaṇam| tāḍanaṃ kuśāgraiḥ huṃphaḍantāstreṇa vidhāya| vauṣaḍantakavacena khananāvakīrṇa pūraṇa (4th line) samīkaraṇa secana kuṭṭana sammārjana lepanānyastreṇa vidhāya| kuṇḍamadhyādiṣu śāntyatītādi kalāmantrānyastvā| (5th line) kalāmayaṃ parikalpya| trisūtreṇāveṣṭya| kalāmayāyakuṇḍāya namaḥ| ityabhyarcya| prāgudagagraṃ tiryagrekhā saharekhācatuṣṭayamubhatra(6th line) triśūlākṛtīnā kuśatrayeṇa vajrīkaraṇam| prāgudagagrakuśābhyāñcatuṣpathañcāstreṇa kuṇḍasyābhyantare(7th line)
samantādutthitagataiḥ kuśai rakṣapāṭaṃ kavacena vidhāya| madhye kūrcarūpaṃ viṣṭaraṃ vāgīśvarāsanāya namaḥ| (8th line) iti datvā| tasmin vāgīśvarīṃ jantumatīṃ sadvā somālyabhūṣaṇām| caturbhujantriṇetrañca vāgīśamapi cintayet|| iti vāgīśvaryai namaḥ|(P.187b,1st line) vāgīśvarāya namaḥ| tau gandhādibhirabhyarcya| agniṃ śarāvādāvānīyāgneyāṃ vinyasya| rākṣasāṃ śaṃ parityajya| nirīkṣaṇādibhirviśodhya|(2nd line)
sapuṣpanārācamudrayā vahnimūrttaye namaḥ| iti bhūtāgniṃ pūrakeṇa gṛhitvā| nābhyagninā bijvagninā saṃyojya| recakeṇa nissārya vahnicaitanyāya namaḥ|(3rd line) iti pātirasthe agnau vinyasya| saṃhitayābhyarcya| digbandhanādividhāya ādāya kuṇḍordhvaṃ tridhāvarjya vitrossaṃyogaṃ vibhāvya|(4th line) bhūmiṣṭhajānumūlena ātmasaṃmukhaṃ nikṣiptvā| nābhideśa samūhyaṃ paridhānasaṃpratiṃ vibhāvya| prakṣālanārthaṃ jalabinduṃ datvā| (5th line) kavacena kāṣṭhaṃ vidhāya| astreṇa prajvālya| garbhāgnaye namaḥ| ityabhyarcya| garbharakṣārthaṃ astrajaptakaṅkaṇaṃ devīhaste badhvā|(6th line) garbhādhānāya sadyenābhyarcya| astreṇāhuti trayaṃ tilai(rhu)rdatvā| puṃsavanārthaṃ tratīye māsi vāmadevenābhyarcya(7th line) śirasāhuti trayaṃ tilaiaida(rhu)tvā| jalabinduṃ datvā| sīmantāya ṣaṣṭhemāsyaghoreṇābhyarcya| śikhayā pūrvavat hṛtvā| vaktrāṅgakalpanāya (8th line) tathaivāhuti hutvā| jananāya daśame māsipuruṣeṇābhyarcya| kavacena pūrvavadhṛtvā| jātenagarbhamālāpaha snānārtham|(P.188a,1stline)
vahnidarbhādyaiḥ sandhukṣyāstreṇa saṃprokṣya| devīhasta kaṅkaṇamuṇmucya| svarṇabandhanaṃ dhyātvābhyarcya| sūtakanivṛttaye kuṇmastreṇa saṃprokṣya(2nd line) darbhāstreṇa tāḍya| kavacenābhyukṣya| prāgudagagrān darbhānastreṇāstīrya| paridhiviṣṭarān hṛdāsaṃsthāpya| vaktrāṇāṃ lālā panodanāya (3rd line) pañcasamidhaśśastreṇa hutvā| pūrvādidikṣu paridhau brahmaviṣṇurudreśvarān abhyarcya| viṣṭareṣu lokeśān yathāsthānaṃ saṃpūjya(4th line)
agniṃ śiśorakṣāṃ vijñāpayet| tatra sṛksṛvau sakuśau gṛhītvāstreṇa saṃprokṣyāgnau pratāpya| kuśāgreṇa tadagraṃ saṃspṛśya| (5th line) punabhrāmya madhyenamadhyaṃ mūlena mūlaṃ saṃspṛśya|kuśaspṛṣṭa pradeśeṣu śivavidyāmākhyāṃ tatvatrayaṃ seśvaramabhyarcya| (6th line) sṛciśaktiṃ sṛvaśaṃbhuṃ nyastvā| kavacena kuśenāveṣṭya| savyabhāge vinyasyājyaṃ samādāya(7th line) nirīkṣaṇādibhirviśodhya| sāṅgaṃ brahmamayaṃ vicintyādāya kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ tridhāvarttāgnigocare vinyasya| kuśenājya bindumādāya brahmaṇe(8th line) svāheti hutvā| svadehaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ dhyātvā| ājyamaiśānyānyastvā| kuśāgreṇaviṣṇave svāheti hutvā| svadehaṃ(P.188b,1st line) rudrarūpaṃ dhyātvā| yonaudhṛtvā rudrāya svāheti hutvā| udvāsya| prādeśamātra madhyagranthi pavitraṃ aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ gṛhītvā|(2nd line) hṛdayenājyaṃ agniṃsaṃmukheṃ tridhotplavanaṃ tadvat ātmasaṃmukhaṃ saṃplavanaṃ kṛtvā| tat gnanthiṃ visarjyāgnau kṣiptvā daṇḍadarbhaṇāstreṇa (3rd line)
jyoti spṛṣṭvāgnau kṣiptvā daṇḍakuśābhyāṃ kavacena nirasyāgnau kṣiptvā|vareṇa daṇḍena darbheṇa ghṛte spṛṣṭvā agnau dahet|(4th line) tataḥ prādeśamātraṃ darbhadvayamadhyagranthipavitraṃ praṇavena ghṛtamadhyenyastvā| dakṣiṇavāmakrameṇa śuklakṛṣṇapakṣadvayaṃ piṅgaleḍā(5th line) suṣumnāṃ vicintya| sṛveṇa savyabhāgādājyamādāya agnaye svāheti dakṣiṇanetre hutvā| vāmabhāgāt ādāya somāya svāheti (6th line) agnirvāmanetre hutvā| madhyādādāyāgnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhetyagni madhyanetre hutvā| punaḥ madhyādādāya| (7th line) agnayesviṣṭakṛta svāhātyegnivaktre ca kiñcit hṛtvā| śeṣamājyaṃ tattat ājyabhāgeṣu svāheti kṣipet| kṛṣṇapakṣe tu (8th line) vāmabhāgādikrameṇa somāya svāhāgnaye svāhā| somāgnibhyāṃ svāhā| agnayesviṣṭakṛte svāhetyagne vāmadakṣiṇamadhyanetreṣu (P.189a,1st line) hutvājyaṃ saṃhitayābhyarcya| digbandhanādikaṃ kṛtvā| hṛdājyabindukṣepādanyājyaśodhanaṃ kuryāt| tataḥ sadyādipañcamantraiḥ(2nd line) recakaikacāhutyā vaktrābhikāraṃ| sadyojātāditva mantreṇavaktrānusandhānam| sadyādimantrānekoccāreṇāgnito vāyuṃgatayā(3rd line)
niṛti īśānaṃ gatayāvaktraikīkaraṇaṃ vidadhyāt| tato nāmakaraṇārthamīśānenābhyarcya| astreṇāhuti trayaṃ tilaiḥ datvā|(4th line) śivāgnisvaṃ hutāśaneti nāmaṃ kṛtvā| vitarau visṛjya cūḍāntakaṃ pūrttaye vauṣaḍantena mūlena pūrṇāndadyāt| carvājyarthamagniṃ vibhajyānyakuṇḍānāṃ (5th line) tattadigatavahniṃ vibhajya| sthānāntare saṃrakṣyamadhya śivāgnivardhanāyākārādyaiḥ svaraiṣoḍaśedhmāni hutvā|(6th line)
satapadmāsanāsīnaṃ pañcavaktraṃ caturbhujam| lambakūrcaṃ brahmamūrttiṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitam|| sṛkmaṇḍaludaṇḍākṣamālāvyagrakarāṃbujam|(7th line)
iti dhyātvā| prārthayet| agnetvamaiśvaraṃ tejaḥpāvanaṃ paraṃ yataḥ| tasmāt tvadiya hṛtpadme saṃsthāpya tarpayāmyaham||(8th line)
ityegneḥ vigrahaṃ madhyanāmyāpraviśya| tanmadhye śivaṃ svāsanaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ abhyarcya|| mantratarpaṇāya mūlenāṣṭottara śataṃdaśāṃśaṃ (P.189a, 1st line) brahmāṅgānāñca hutvā| pūrṇāṃdatvā| deśakālapātanadurnimitta śānti sunimittāpātanāya ca pratyekaṃ mūlenayathāśakti hutvā|(2nd line) mūlabrahmāṅgamantrai svāhāntairekaikayā hutyātarpaṇam| oṃ humaṃ hauṃ huṃ śivāyā huṃphaṭ| oṃ huṃ hoṃ huṃ īśānamūrdhne huṃphaṭ|(3rd line) oṃ huṃ heṃ huṃtatpuruṣavaktrāya huṃphaṭ| oṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ aghorahṛdayāya huṃphaṭ| ityādyastramantrāntaṃ pratyekaṃ (4th line) tridhāhutyādīpanam| vidadhyāt| tatomūrttipāḥ svasvakuṇḍeṣu kuṇḍasaṃskāraṃ vidhāya| pradhānakuṇḍādagniṃ (5th line) tattaddiggataṃ tattat kuṇḍe saṃyojya| kavacenakāṣṭhaṃ nidhāya| astreṇa prajvālya| paristīrya paridhiviṣṭarān saṃsthāpya| paridhiviṣṭarastha(6th line) brahmādīnindrādīn abhyarcya| sṛksṛvājyamapipūrvavat saṃskṛtya| agniṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ santoṣya| pūrvadakṣiṇottarapaścimakuṇḍeṣu puruṣāghoravāmasadyojātānabhyarcya| agneśāna naiṛtavāyukuṇḍeṣu| sṛkśiraḥ śikhākavacānabhyarcya|(8th line)
tattanmantreṇa mantratarpaṇāya pañcavimśatyāhutiṃ hutvā| samidādidravyai pradhānārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā hutvā| prāyaścittārthaṃ mantreṇa yathāśakti hutvā|(P.190a,1st line)
pūrṇāṃ datvā tattat devamabhyarcya| pradhānakuṃbhe tattasthāne saṃyojya|tattat kuṇḍasyaparidhi viṣṭarasthānudvāsya| paridhi(2nd line) paristarān prasṛtya| tattat kuṇḍastha vahnipradhānakuṇḍe tattat sthāne saṃyojayeyuḥ| gurūsthālīpākavidhānena carūn niṣpādyasamidājyaṃ (3rd line) na lāja tila sarṣapamudgamāṣāḍhakayava vaiṇava dravyānyā samidādi mudgāntaṃ saptadravyānvā tilāntapañcadravyānvā|pratyekaṃ(4th line) mūlenāṣṭottaraśataṃ tadardhaṃ vā daśāṃśaṃ brahmāṅgānāñca hutvā| pūrṇāṃ datvā| prāyaścittārthaṃ mūlenāghoreṇāstreṇa pratyekaṃ (5th line) śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā hutvā| pūrṇāṃ dadyāt| tatognisthāyabhagavate naivedya candana tāṃbūlādi datvāṣṭapuṣpikayābhyarcya|(6th line) praṇipatya parāṅmukhārghyaṃ datvā dhṛtvāsanādikaṃ nārācamudrayotthāpya saṃyujya| śivakuṃbhe saṃyojya| vahniṃ vyāhṛtibhiḥ (7th line) hutvānirudhya paridhiviṣṭarastha brahmādibhyo balindatvā| tānnirūdhyāntarbali bahirbalindatvā(dyurarapebhyo)(?) balindatvā|(8th line)
pādauprakṣālācamya sakalīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt| tato grāmādibalipradānārthaṃ pūrvavadastrarājānna liṅgādibhiḥ(P.190b,1st line) saha dhvajādibhiḥ saha dhvajādimahāpīṭhāntaṃ vā brahmādi pīṭhāntañcakrādi pīṭhāntaṃ vā pūrvavat tattattālarāgavādyasahitaṃ tattalokapāla(2nd line) balīpradānopetaṃ dinabaliñca vidhāyālayaṃ praviśyamahāpūṭhenityavat baliṃ kṣipet| dinabaliryathātatra prathamadivasādi navadināntaṃ (3rd line) vighnabhūtṛṣīndra brahmaviṣṇu rudreśvara sadāśivān pratidinamekaikadevaṃ sāyaṃprātaraṣṭadikṣvapi baliṃ vidadhyāt| tatbalidravyabhedaṃ (4th line) laḍḍukāpūpaphala gulamiśriṃdadhyannañca phalarajanīcūrṇa ghṛtadadhisaktu miśraṃ kṛsarānnañca| padmamūlakuśāgra(5th line) phalaghṛta miśraṃ śālyannañca| indravallī priyaṅgughṛtamiśraṃ haridrānnañca rātri pūrṇapadma puṣpalājamiśraṃ pāyasānnañca|(6th line) brahatīphalājyamiśraṃ gulānnañca| nālikera kadalīpanasa dadhighṛtamiśraṃ veṇyannañca| lājapuṣpadadhighṛtamiśraṃ (7th line) śuddhānnañca yathākramaṃ baliṃ kuryāt| utsaveśvarayānārthantamalaṅkṛtyāstra prokṣitaṃ tattadāsanamantrārcitaṃ (8th line) tattadarcitantattadāsanamadhiropya| sarvālaṅkāropetaṃ vidhāya viśudhyālaṅkṛtāyāṃ vīthikāyāndevasya purate viṣayantra (P.191a1st line) maṇayantrādikān devasya praṣṭhatodevīcaṇjādikāṃ nītvā|yathākramaṃ grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kārayitvā layaṃ praviśyāsthānamaṇḍapasthāya ( 2nd line) pādyādikaṃ dhūpadīpādikaṃ ca dāpayet| tato yātrārthasnapanārthamutsaveśvarasannidhau sthaṇḍilaṃ samkalpya| (3rd line) navakalaśādisnapanabhedena vibhavān sāreṇa saṅkalpya| pañcagavyaṃ samsthāpya śāntihomaṃ kṛtvā yathāpadabhiṣecayet| atha (4th line)
viśeṣapūjārthaṃ devaṃ vividhavasanakūsumādibhiralaṅkṛtyāsanamūrtyādyāparavaraṇāntaṃ abhyarcya| phalāpūpādisahitaṃ (5th line) mahānaivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpya dhūpadīpaṃ dāpayet| vinodadarśanāya gītavādyatālarāgasahitaṃ (6th line) nṛrtaṃ pariveṣakrameṇadevāyadayitvālayāntaḥ praviśya| devyasahaniveśanāya devadavīṃ yathocitasaparyā(7th line) santoṣaye devaṃ rajanyāmahanyapi prātagurūṃ nityakarmavidhāya yāgamaṇḍapaṃ praviśya| sūryatoraṇatvārapālādi (8th line) gurūprajannāntaṃ maṇḍapasamskāraṃ yāgeśvarakuṃbhaṃ tamaṇaṃ ca gītamaṇḍapapūjāṃ vidhāya| vedikākuṃbhe nirmālyaṃ (P.191b,1st line) panīyasāsanaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ pūrvavadabhyarcya| vardhanīṃ vidyeśvarāpañcasampūjya kuṃbhasthā(......)bhagavate naivedyādikaṃ datvā| kuṇḍasakāśametya ( 2nd line) atreṇā samprokṣya kavacena kāṣṭhaṃ nidhāya| astreṇaprajvālya| paridhiviṣṭarasthānabhyarcya| sruksruvājyamapipūrvavat samskṛtya| (3rd line) śivāgnauvyāsratibhirjutvā| tanmaddhe śivaṃ pūrvavadabhyarcya mantratarpaṇāhuti deśakālādyārhutvā| pūrṇāṃ datvāt sarveśvarāya (4th line) prātaḥkālārcanaṃ kṛtvā yāgamaṇḍapaveśanaṃ homaṃ baliṃ radhāprarohaṇaṃ dhānaṃ ca pūrvavatvidhāya| āsthānamaṇḍapasthāya (5th line) nālikerādyupahārādi samarpya madhyānhanityaṃ vidhāya| yātrārthasnapanaṃ viśeṣārcanaṃ| viśeṣadarśanaṃ ca (6th line) vidadhyā devaṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ pratyahamevaṃ naivedya| prātassandhyārcanamityādi nāsāyaṃ prātarutsave (7th line) śvarasya ṣoḍaśakriyā bhavanti| anantaraṃ tailābhyaṅgane ṭeśabhramaṇaṃ| mṛgayātrāṃ yathoktena vidhāya| tīrthāṇyapūrvarātrau (P.192a,1st line) snapanavelāyāṃ pūrvakautukaṃ mumucya| viśeṣāt nasamadhetīrdhāthāṃ punaḥ kautukabandhanaṃ kṛtvā| paredivase ( 2nd line) sūryodayāt pūrvameva nadyādide śestrarājaṃ vinyasya| tadagre navakalaśaṃ samsthāpya| madhyakuṃbhe manonmanīṃ paratoṣṭakuṃbhe ṣugaṃgāditīrthān (3rd line) sampūjyāstrarājamabhyarcya| jalamadhyaṃ nītvā| kuṃbhairabhiṣicya tajjalenamapagāhya hedevigaṅge(4th line) yamunetyādi tīrthānāhūyyaraverastamayaṃ yāvattāvattiṣṭhānvitiprājñākastrarājamālāyaṃ praveśayet|(5th line) utsaveśvarasya prātassalyārcanaṃ kṛtvā| homaṃ baliṃ yānaṃ ca pūrnanatvidhāya|(6th line) āsthānamaṇḍapasthāyaśaṃbhave pūrvaṃ nālikerādyupahārādi samarcya cūrṇotsavāt devasyāgre sthaṇḍilatrayaṃ kṛtvā| tatraikatratriśūlaṃ tadagre musalo(7th line) lūkhalaṃ tadagre bherikāṃ vinyasya| saṅkalpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā strarājamabhyarcya| naivedyādikaṃ datvā| ulūkhaleṣadhutdhāsanamabhyarcya|(P. 192b,1st line) ulūkhaletrikhaṇḍe śivatatvādi tatvatrayaṃ seśvaramabhyarcya| musalaṃ kūrcadāmādibhiralaṅkratya| tasmin tatvatrayau ( 2nd line) seśvaramabhyarcyā lūkhalevāgīśvarīṃ musale vāgīśvaraṃ gandhādibhirabhyarcya| ulūkhalaparitaḥ āgneyādikoṇeṣu tailadūrvākṣata (3rd line)
tāmbūlāṃ kūrāṇipradhak pradhak pātrevinyasya| svasvanāmnā samabhyarcya tadagrasthaṇḍilabherīṃ sampūjya| cūrṇarakṣārtaṃ (4th line) rākṣasoccāṭanāya bherīṃ samtāḍyā pādakamāhūya tālāni vādayet| tatolūkhalāvaṭerajanīcūrṇaṃ nikṣipya(5th line) musalenadaśākṣareṇatridhā kuru|śivagītagāyakairmāheśvarai rudrakanyābhiśca dūrvādānakrameṇa kuṭṭayet(6th line) tatcūrṇaṃ paratresamādāya tailaṃ kiñcit prakṣipya| māyāśktimanunābhyarcya liṅgātthaṃdevyarthamutsavapratimārthaṃ (7th line) śūlānthaṃ ca vibharjya| tattaddevasamīpaṃ gatvā| dūrvākṣatairabhyarcya tāmbūlaṃ samarpya| tailapūrvaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ P.193a,1st line aṅkurañca tattanmantreṇa datvā| dhūpadīpaudatvā viśiṣṭacūrṇamaṅguraṃ ca bhaktebhyo dāpayet| mahātīrthārtaṃ nadyādideśamupagamya|( 2nd line) tadaiśasthaṇḍilestrarājaṃ tat purasthaṇaḍile kalaśāṃśca vinyasya| astrarājaṃ kuṃbhāmśca pūrvavadabhyarcya| snātvā kautukaṃ (3rd line) mumucyāvagāhya gandhapuṣpādibhirabhyarcyā layaṃpraveśayet| utsaveśvaraṃ tatra pātraṃ vā kautukaṃ mumucya|(4th line)
snapanādyairabhiṣicya naivedyādikaṃ gāpayet| tato guruḥ stadutryāṃ makhālayaṃ praviśya| maṇḍapakalaśānabhyarcya|(5th line) yāgeśvarakuṃbhānārādhya| kuṇḍaprokṣaṇādimantratarpaṇāntaṃ karbha vidhāya| prāyaścittāhutiṃ kṛtvā|(6th line) jayādirabhyādhānaṃ rāṣṭubhutkuśmāhutimindāhuti mahāvyāṇradibhiśca kriyaṃ bakenayathāśaktiṃ hutvā| pūrṇāṃ datvāgnisthāya (7th line) bhagavate naivedyādikaṃ datvā prārthaṣṭapuṣpikayābhyarcya| nirodhārghyaṃ datvā| kuṃbhe samyojyāgniṃ visṛjya|(P.193b,1st line) paridhiviṣṭarasthān tvāsya| paritvādīn praṇutya kuṇḍākhanayabhāge caturaṇūmaṇḍalatvayaṃ kṛtvā| paścime prathamamaṇḍale pūrvādi ( 2nd line) dikṣu| rudrebhyonamaḥ| mātṛbhyo namaḥ| gaṇebhyo namaḥ yakṣebhyo namaḥ īśānādiṣu gṛhebhyo namaḥ daityabhyo namaḥ niśācarebhyo namaḥ (3rd line) nāgebhyo namaḥ maṇḍalābhyantaraiśānāgninṛteṣu nakṣatrebhyo namaḥ rāśibhyo namaḥ viśvebhyo namaḥ (4th line) varuṇavāyurmadhye kṣetreśāya namaḥ pūrvamaṇḍale lokapālānabhyarcya| tanmaṇḍalamadhye nīlalohitāya namaḥ|(5th line) tanmaṇḍalabāhye vādhāsādibhyassamayavedibhyo namaḥ| ityabhyarcya| svāhāntai svasvanmantraiḥ baliṃ datvā| tānutvāsya (6th line) saurādi maṇḍapakalaśasthānutvāhya| pādauprakṣālyācamet| tataśuddhabhūtalaviṣṭarasthaṃ guruṃ śivavat sampūjya| (7th line) gobhūhiraṇyādikaṃ datvā| tvārapūjādiliṅgaśuddhiṃ vidhāya| yathoktenābhyarcya yāgeśvarakuṃbhānabhiṣicya| vardhanyāṃ (P.194a,1st line)
